attribute.name: StadiumOrArena
attribute.description: A stadium.

attribute.name: State
attribute.description: A state or province of a country.

attribute.name: Statement
attribute.description: A statement about something, for example a fun or interesting fact. If known, the main entity this statement is about can be indicated using mainEntity. For more formal claims (e.g. in Fact Checking), consider using [[Claim]] instead. Use the [[text]] property to capture the text of the statement.

attribute.name: StatisticalPopulation
attribute.description: A StatisticalPopulation is a set of instances of a certain given type that satisfy some set of constraints. The property [[populationType]] is used to specify the type. Any property that can be used on instances of that type can appear on the statistical population. For example, a [[StatisticalPopulation]] representing all [[Person]]s with a [[homeLocation]] of East Podunk California would be described by applying the appropriate [[homeLocation]] and [[populationType]] properties to a [[StatisticalPopulation]] item that stands for that set of people. The properties [[numConstraints]] and [[constraintProperty]] are used to specify which of the populations properties are used to specify the population. Note that the sense of "population" used here is the general sense of a statistical population, and does not imply that the population consists of people. For example, a [[populationType]] of [[Event]] or [[NewsArticle]] could be used. See also [[Observation]], where a [[populationType]] such as [[Person]] or [[Event]] can be indicated directly. In most cases it may be better to use [[StatisticalVariable]] instead of [[StatisticalPopulation]].

attribute.name: StatisticalVariable
attribute.description: [[StatisticalVariable]] represents any type of statistical metric that can be measured at a place and time. The usage pattern for [[StatisticalVariable]] is typically expressed using [[Observation]] with an explicit [[populationType]], which is a type, typically drawn from Schema.org. Each [[StatisticalVariable]] is marked as a [[ConstraintNode]], meaning that some properties (those listed using [[constraintProperty]]) serve in this setting solely to define the statistical variable rather than literally describe a specific person, place or thing. For example, a [[StatisticalVariable]] Median_Height_Person_Female representing the median height of women, could be written as follows: the population type is [[Person]]; the measuredProperty [[height]]; the [[statType]] [[median]]; the [[gender]] [[Female]]. It is important to note that there are many kinds of scientific quantitative observation which are not fully, perfectly or unambiguously described following this pattern, or with solely Schema.org terminology. The approach taken here is designed to allow partial, incremental or minimal description of [[StatisticalVariable]]s, and the use of detailed sets of entity and property IDs from external repositories. The [[measurementMethod]], [[unitCode]] and [[unitText]] properties can also be used to clarify the specific nature and notation of an observed measurement.

attribute.name: StatusEnumeration
attribute.description: Lists or enumerations dealing with status types.

attribute.name: SteeringPositionValue
attribute.description: A value indicating a steering position.

attribute.name: Store
attribute.description: A retail good store.

attribute.name: StructuredValue
attribute.description: Structured values are used when the value of a property has a more complex structure than simply being a textual value or a reference to another thing.

attribute.name: SubscribeAction
attribute.description:
The act of forming a personal connection with someone/something (object) unidirectionally/asymmetrically to get updates pushed to.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, SubscribeAction implies that the subscriber acts as a passive agent being constantly/actively pushed for updates.
* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, SubscribeAction implies that the agent is interested in continuing receiving updates from the object.
* [[JoinAction]]: Unlike JoinAction, SubscribeAction implies that the agent is interested in continuing receiving updates from the object.

attribute.name: Substance
attribute.description: Any matter of defined composition that has discrete existence, whose origin may be biological, mineral or chemical.

attribute.name: SubwayStation
attribute.description: A subway station.

attribute.name: Suite
attribute.description:
A suite in a hotel or other public accommodation, denotes a class of luxury accommodations, the key feature of which is multiple rooms (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suite_(hotel)).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

attribute.name: SuperficialAnatomy
attribute.description: Anatomical features that can be observed by sight (without dissection), including the form and proportions of the human body as well as surface landmarks that correspond to deeper subcutaneous structures. Superficial anatomy plays an important role in sports medicine, phlebotomy, and other medical specialties as underlying anatomical structures can be identified through surface palpation. For example, during back surgery, superficial anatomy can be used to palpate and count vertebrae to find the site of incision. Or in phlebotomy, superficial anatomy can be used to locate an underlying vein; for example, the median cubital vein can be located by palpating the borders of the cubital fossa (such as the epicondyles of the humerus) and then looking for the superficial signs of the vein, such as size, prominence, ability to refill after depression, and feel of surrounding tissue support. As another example, in a subluxation (dislocation) of the glenohumeral joint, the bony structure becomes pronounced with the deltoid muscle failing to cover the glenohumeral joint allowing the edges of the scapula to be superficially visible. Here, the superficial anatomy is the visible edges of the scapula, implying the underlying dislocation of the joint (the related anatomical structure).

attribute.name: SurgicalProcedure
attribute.description: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments; performed for diagnose, or therapeutic purposes.

attribute.name: SuspendAction
attribute.description: The act of momentarily pausing a device or application (e.g. pause music playback or pause a timer).

attribute.name: Syllabus
attribute.description: A syllabus that describes the material covered in a course, often with several such sections per [[Course]] so that a distinct [[timeRequired]] can be provided for that section of the [[Course]].

attribute.name: Synagogue
attribute.description: A synagogue.

attribute.name: TVClip
attribute.description: A short TV program or a segment/part of a TV program.

attribute.name: TVEpisode
attribute.description: A TV episode which can be part of a series or season.

attribute.name: TVSeason
attribute.description: Season dedicated to TV broadcast and associated online delivery.

attribute.name: TVSeries
attribute.description: CreativeWorkSeries dedicated to TV broadcast and associated online delivery.

attribute.name: Table
attribute.description: A table on a Web page.

attribute.name: TakeAction
attribute.description:
The act of gaining ownership of an object from an origin. Reciprocal of GiveAction.

Related actions:

* [[GiveAction]]: The reciprocal of TakeAction.
* [[ReceiveAction]]: Unlike ReceiveAction, TakeAction implies that ownership has been transferred.

attribute.name: TattooParlor
attribute.description: A tattoo parlor.

attribute.name: Taxi
attribute.description: A taxi.

attribute.name: TaxiReservation
attribute.description: A reservation for a taxi.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

attribute.name: TaxiService
attribute.description: A service for a vehicle for hire with a driver for local travel. Fares are usually calculated based on distance traveled.

attribute.name: TaxiStand
attribute.description: A taxi stand.

attribute.name: Taxon
attribute.description: A set of organisms asserted to represent a natural cohesive biological unit.

attribute.name: TechArticle
attribute.description: A technical article - Example: How-to (task) topics, step-by-step, procedural troubleshooting, specifications, etc.

attribute.name: TelevisionChannel
attribute.description: A unique instance of a television BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

attribute.name: TelevisionStation
attribute.description: A television station.

attribute.name: TennisComplex
attribute.description: A tennis complex.

attribute.name: Text
attribute.description: Data type: Text.

attribute.name: TextDigitalDocument
attribute.description: A file composed primarily of text.

attribute.name: TextObject
attribute.description: A text file. The text can be unformatted or contain markup, html, etc.

attribute.name: TheaterEvent
attribute.description: Event type: Theater performance.

attribute.name: TheaterGroup
attribute.description: A theater group or company, for example, the Royal Shakespeare Company or Druid Theatre.

attribute.name: TherapeuticProcedure
attribute.description: A medical procedure intended primarily for therapeutic purposes, aimed at improving a health condition.

attribute.name: Thesis
attribute.description: A thesis or dissertation document submitted in support of candidature for an academic degree or professional qualification.

attribute.name: Thing
attribute.description: The most generic type of item.

attribute.name: Ticket
attribute.description: Used to describe a ticket to an event, a flight, a bus ride, etc.

attribute.name: TieAction
attribute.description: The act of reaching a draw in a competitive activity.

attribute.name: TierBenefitEnumeration
attribute.description: An enumeration of possible benefits as part of a loyalty (members) program.

attribute.name: Time
attribute.description: A point in time recurring on multiple days in the form hh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] (see [XML schema for details](http://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#time)).

attribute.name: TipAction
attribute.description: The act of giving money voluntarily to a beneficiary in recognition of services rendered.

attribute.name: TireShop
attribute.description: A tire shop.

attribute.name: TouristAttraction
attribute.description: A tourist attraction. In principle any Thing can be a [[TouristAttraction]], from a [[Mountain]] and [[LandmarksOrHistoricalBuildings]] to a [[LocalBusiness]]. This Type can be used on its own to describe a general [[TouristAttraction]], or be used as an [[additionalType]] to add tourist attraction properties to any other type. (See examples below)

attribute.name: TouristDestination
attribute.description: A tourist destination. In principle any [[Place]] can be a [[TouristDestination]] from a [[City]], Region or [[Country]] to an [[AmusementPark]] or [[Hotel]]. This Type can be used on its own to describe a general [[TouristDestination]], or be used as an [[additionalType]] to add tourist relevant properties to any other [[Place]]. A [[TouristDestination]] is defined as a [[Place]] that contains, or is colocated with, one or more [[TouristAttraction]]s, often linked by a similar theme or interest to a particular [[touristType]]. The [UNWTO](http://www2.unwto.org/) defines Destination (main destination of a tourism trip) as the place visited that is central to the decision to take the trip. (See examples below.)

attribute.name: TouristInformationCenter
attribute.description: A tourist information center.

attribute.name: TouristTrip
attribute.description: A tourist trip. A created itinerary of visits to one or more places of interest ([[TouristAttraction]]/[[TouristDestination]]) often linked by a similar theme, geographic area, or interest to a particular [[touristType]]. The [UNWTO](http://www2.unwto.org/) defines tourism trip as the Trip taken by visitors. (See examples below.)

attribute.name: ToyStore
attribute.description: A toy store.

attribute.name: TrackAction
attribute.description:
An agent tracks an object for updates.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, TrackAction refers to the interest on the location of innanimates objects.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, TrackAction refers to the interest on the location of innanimate objects.

attribute.name: TradeAction
attribute.description: The act of participating in an exchange of goods and services for monetary compensation. An agent trades an object, product or service with a participant in exchange for a one time or periodic payment.

attribute.name: TrainReservation
attribute.description: A reservation for train travel.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

attribute.name: TrainStation
attribute.description: A train station.

attribute.name: TrainTrip
attribute.description: A trip on a commercial train line.

attribute.name: TransferAction
attribute.description: The act of transferring/moving (abstract or concrete) animate or inanimate objects from one place to another.

attribute.name: TravelAction
attribute.description: The act of traveling from a fromLocation to a destination by a specified mode of transport, optionally with participants.

attribute.name: TravelAgency
attribute.description: A travel agency.

attribute.name: TreatmentIndication
attribute.description: An indication for treating an underlying condition, symptom, etc.

attribute.name: Trip
attribute.description: A trip or journey. An itinerary of visits to one or more places.

attribute.name: TypeAndQuantityNode
attribute.description: A structured value indicating the quantity, unit of measurement, and business function of goods included in a bundle offer.

attribute.name: UKNonprofitType
attribute.description: UKNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the United Kingdom.

attribute.name: URL
attribute.description: Data type: URL.

attribute.name: USNonprofitType
attribute.description: USNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the United States.

attribute.name: UnRegisterAction

The act of un-registering from a service.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: antonym of UnRegisterAction.
* [[LeaveAction]]: Unlike LeaveAction, UnRegisterAction implies that you are unregistering from a service you were previously registered, rather than leaving a team/group of people.

attribute.name: UnitPriceSpecification
attribute.description: The price asked for a given offer by the respective organization or person.

attribute.name: UpdateAction
attribute.description: The act of managing by changing/editing the state of the object.

attribute.name: UseAction
attribute.description: The act of applying an object to its intended purpose.

attribute.name: UserBlocks
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserCheckins
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserComments
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserDownloads
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserInteraction
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserLikes
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserPageVisits
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserPlays
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserPlusOnes
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: UserReview
attribute.description: A review created by an end-user (e.g. consumer, purchaser, attendee etc.), in contrast with [[CriticReview]].

attribute.name: UserTweets
attribute.description: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

attribute.name: VacationRental
attribute.description: A kind of lodging business that focuses on renting single properties for limited time.

attribute.name: Vehicle
attribute.description: A vehicle is a device that is designed or used to transport people or cargo over land, water, air, or through space.

attribute.name: Vein
attribute.description: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries blood to the heart.

attribute.name: Vessel
attribute.description: A component of the human body circulatory system comprised of an intricate network of hollow tubes that transport blood throughout the entire body.

attribute.name: VeterinaryCare
attribute.description: A vet's office.

attribute.name: VideoGallery
attribute.description: Web page type: Video gallery page.

attribute.name: VideoGame
attribute.description: A video game is an electronic game that involves human interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device.

attribute.name: VideoGameClip
attribute.description: A short segment/part of a video game.

attribute.name: VideoGameSeries
attribute.description: A video game series.

attribute.name: VideoObject
attribute.description: A video file.

attribute.name: VideoObjectSnapshot
attribute.description: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of a [[VideoObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

attribute.name: ViewAction
attribute.description: The act of consuming static visual content.

attribute.name: VirtualLocation
attribute.description: An online or virtual location for attending events. For example, one may attend an online seminar or educational event. While a virtual location may be used as the location of an event, virtual locations should not be confused with physical locations in the real world.

attribute.name: VisualArtsEvent
attribute.description: Event type: Visual arts event.

attribute.name: VisualArtwork
attribute.description: A work of art that is primarily visual in character.

attribute.name: VitalSign
attribute.description: Vital signs are measures of various physiological functions in order to assess the most basic body functions.

attribute.name: Volcano
attribute.description: A volcano, like Fujisan.

attribute.name: VoteAction
attribute.description: The act of expressing a preference from a fixed/finite/structured set of choices/options.

attribute.name: WPAdBlock
attribute.description: An advertising section of the page.

attribute.name: WPFooter
attribute.description: The footer section of the page.

attribute.name: WPHeader
attribute.description: The header section of the page.

attribute.name: WPSideBar
attribute.description: A sidebar section of the page.

attribute.name: WantAction
attribute.description: The act of expressing a desire about the object. An agent wants an object.

attribute.name: WarrantyPromise
attribute.description: A structured value representing the duration and scope of services that will be provided to a customer free of charge in case of a defect or malfunction of a product.

attribute.name: WarrantyScope
attribute.description:
A range of services that will be provided to a customer free of charge in case of a defect or malfunction of a product.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Labor-BringIn
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PartsAndLabor-BringIn
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PartsAndLabor-PickUp

attribute.name: WatchAction
attribute.description: The act of consuming dynamic/moving visual content.

attribute.name: Waterfall
attribute.description: A waterfall, like Niagara.

attribute.name: WearAction
attribute.description: The act of dressing oneself in clothing.

attribute.name: WearableMeasurementTypeEnumeration
attribute.description: Enumerates common types of measurement for wearables products.

attribute.name: WearableSizeGroupEnumeration
attribute.description: Enumerates common size groups (also known as "size types") for wearable products.

attribute.name: WearableSizeSystemEnumeration
attribute.description: Enumerates common size systems specific for wearable products.

attribute.name: WebAPI
attribute.description: An application programming interface accessible over Web/Internet technologies.

attribute.name: WebApplication
attribute.description: Web applications.

attribute.name: WebContent
attribute.description: WebContent is a type representing all [[WebPage]], [[WebSite]] and [[WebPageElement]] content. It is sometimes the case that detailed distinctions between Web pages, sites and their parts are not always important or obvious. The [[WebContent]] type makes it easier to describe Web-addressable content without requiring such distinctions to always be stated. (The intent is that the existing types [[WebPage]], [[WebSite]] and [[WebPageElement]] will eventually be declared as subtypes of [[WebContent]].)

attribute.name: WebPage
attribute.description: A web page. Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage, so the various properties about that webpage, such as breadcrumb may be used. We recommend explicit declaration if these properties are specified, but if they are found outside of an itemscope, they will be assumed to be about the page.

attribute.name: WebPageElement
attribute.description: A web page element, like a table or an image.

attribute.name: WebSite
attribute.description: A WebSite is a set of related web pages and other items typically served from a single web domain and accessible via URLs.

attribute.name: WholesaleStore
attribute.description: A wholesale store.

attribute.name: WinAction
attribute.description: The act of achieving victory in a competitive activity.

attribute.name: Winery
attribute.description: A winery.

attribute.name: WorkBasedProgram
attribute.description: A program with both an educational and employment component. Typically based at a workplace and structured around work-based learning, with the aim of instilling competencies related to an occupation. WorkBasedProgram is used to distinguish programs such as apprenticeships from school, college or other classroom based educational programs.

attribute.name: WorkersUnion
attribute.description: A Workers Union (also known as a Labor Union, Labour Union, or Trade Union) is an organization that promotes the interests of its worker members by collectively bargaining with management, organizing, and political lobbying.

attribute.name: WriteAction
attribute.description: The act of authoring written creative content.

attribute.name: XPathType
attribute.description: Text representing an XPath (typically but not necessarily version 1.0).

attribute.name: Zoo
attribute.description: A zoo.

attribute.name: about
attribute.description: The subject matter of an object.
attribute.applies_to: DefinedTerm, Event, Certification, CreativeWork, DefinedTermSet, CommunicateAction

attribute.name: abridged
attribute.description: Indicates whether the book is an abridged edition.

attribute.name: abstract
attribute.description: An abstract is a short description that summarizes a [[CreativeWork]].

attribute.name: accelerationTime
attribute.description:
The time needed to accelerate the vehicle from a given start velocity to a given target velocity.

Typical unit code(s): SEC for seconds

* Note: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for seconds/0..100 km/h or seconds/0..60 mph. Simply use "SEC" for seconds and indicate the velocities in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]], or use [[valueReference]] with a [[QuantitativeValue]] of 0..60 mph or 0..100 km/h to specify the reference speeds.

attribute.name: acceptedAnswer
attribute.description: The answer(s) that has been accepted as best, typically on a Question/Answer site. Sites vary in their selection mechanisms, e.g. drawing on community opinion and/or the view of the Question author.

attribute.name: acceptedOffer
attribute.description: The offer(s) -- e.g., product, quantity and price combinations -- included in the order.

attribute.name: acceptedPaymentMethod
attribute.description: The payment method(s) that are accepted in general by an organization, or for some specific demand or offer.

attribute.name: acceptsReservations
attribute.description: Indicates whether a FoodEstablishment accepts reservations. Values can be Boolean, an URL at which reservations can be made or (for backwards compatibility) the strings ```Yes``` or ```No```.

attribute.name: accessCode
attribute.description: Password, PIN, or access code needed for delivery (e.g. from a locker).

attribute.name: accessMode
attribute.description: The human sensory perceptual system or cognitive faculty through which a person may process or perceive the intellectual content of a resource, not including any adaptations of the content (e.g., text alternatives for images). Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessMode-vocabulary).

attribute.name: accessModeSufficient
attribute.description: A list of single or combined access modes that are sufficient to understand all the intellectual content of a resource, including any adaptations. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessModeSufficient-vocabulary).

attribute.name: accessibilityAPI
attribute.description: Indicates that the resource is compatible with the referenced accessibility API. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityAPI-vocabulary).

attribute.name: accessibilityControl
attribute.description: Identifies input methods that are sufficient to fully control the described resource. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityControl-vocabulary).

attribute.name: accessibilityFeature
attribute.description: Content features of the resource, such as accessible media, alternatives and supported enhancements for accessibility. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityFeature-vocabulary).

attribute.name: accessibilityHazard
attribute.description: A characteristic of the described resource that is physiologically dangerous to some users. Related to WCAG 2.0 guideline 2.3. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityHazard-vocabulary).

attribute.name: accessibilitySummary
attribute.description: A human-readable summary of specific accessibility features or deficiencies, consistent with the other accessibility metadata but expressing subtleties such as "short descriptions are present but long descriptions will be needed for non-visual users" or "short descriptions are present and no long descriptions are needed".

attribute.name: accommodationCategory
attribute.description: Category of an [[Accommodation]], following real estate conventions, e.g. RESO (see [PropertySubType](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/PropertySubType+Field), and [PropertyType](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/PropertyType+Field) fields for suggested values).

attribute.name: accommodationFloorPlan
attribute.description: A floorplan of some [[Accommodation]].

attribute.name: accountId
attribute.description: The identifier for the account the payment will be applied to.

attribute.name: accountMinimumInflow
attribute.description: A minimum amount that has to be paid in every month.

attribute.name: accountOverdraftLimit
attribute.description: An overdraft is an extension of credit from a lending institution when an account reaches zero. An overdraft allows the individual to continue withdrawing money even if the account has no funds in it. Basically the bank allows people to borrow a set amount of money.

attribute.name: accountablePerson
attribute.description: Specifies the Person that is legally accountable for the CreativeWork.

attribute.name: acquireLicensePage
attribute.description: Indicates a page documenting how licenses can be purchased or otherwise acquired, for the current item.

attribute.name: acquiredFrom
attribute.description: The organization or person from which the product was acquired.

attribute.name: acrissCode
attribute.description: The ACRISS Car Classification Code is a code used by many car rental companies, for classifying vehicles. ACRISS stands for Association of Car Rental Industry Systems and Standards.

attribute.name: actionAccessibilityRequirement
attribute.description: A set of requirements that must be fulfilled in order to perform an Action. If more than one value is specified, fulfilling one set of requirements will allow the Action to be performed.

attribute.name: actionApplication
attribute.description: An application that can complete the request.

attribute.name: actionOption
attribute.description: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

attribute.name: actionPlatform
attribute.description: The high level platform(s) where the Action can be performed for the given URL. To specify a specific application or operating system instance, use actionApplication.

attribute.name: actionProcess
attribute.description: Description of the process by which the action was performed.

attribute.name: actionStatus
attribute.description: Indicates the current disposition of the Action.

attribute.name: actionableFeedbackPolicy
attribute.description: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement about public engagement activities (for news media, the newsroom’s), including involving the public - digitally or otherwise -- in coverage decisions, reporting and activities after publication.

attribute.name: activeIngredient
attribute.description: An active ingredient, typically chemical compounds and/or biologic substances.

attribute.name: activityDuration
attribute.description: Length of time to engage in the activity.

attribute.name: activityFrequency
attribute.description: How often one should engage in the activity.

attribute.name: actor
attribute.description: An actor (individual or a group), e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc., or in an event. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.
attribute.applies_to: Event, PodcastSeries, VideoObject, RadioSeries, TVSeries, VideoGame, Clip, Episode, CreativeWorkSeason, MovieSeries, Movie, VideoGameSeries

attribute.name: actors
attribute.description: An actor, e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.
attribute.applies_to: TVSeries, VideoGame, Episode, Clip, Movie, MovieSeries, VideoGameSeries, VideoObject, RadioSeries

attribute.name: addOn
attribute.description: An additional offer that can only be obtained in combination with the first base offer (e.g. supplements and extensions that are available for a surcharge).

attribute.name: additionalName
attribute.description: An additional name for a Person, can be used for a middle name.

attribute.name: additionalNumberOfGuests
attribute.description: If responding yes, the number of guests who will attend in addition to the invitee.

attribute.name: additionalProperty
attribute.description: A property-value pair representing an additional characteristic of the entity, e.g. a product feature or another characteristic for which there is no matching property in schema.org.\n\nNote: Publishers should be aware that applications designed to use specific schema.org properties (e.g. https://schema.org/width, https://schema.org/color, https://schema.org/gtin13, ...) will typically expect such data to be provided using those properties, rather than using the generic property/value mechanism.
attribute.applies_to: MerchantReturnPolicy, Product, QualitativeValue, Offer, Place, QuantitativeValue

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.description: An additional type for the item, typically used for adding more specific types from external vocabularies in microdata syntax. This is a relationship between something and a class that the thing is in. Typically the value is a URI-identified RDF class, and in this case corresponds to the use of rdf:type in RDF. Text values can be used sparingly, for cases where useful information can be added without their being an appropriate schema to reference. In the case of text values, the class label should follow the schema.org style guide.

attribute.name: additionalVariable
attribute.description: Any additional component of the exercise prescription that may need to be articulated to the patient. This may include the order of exercises, the number of repetitions of movement, quantitative distance, progressions over time, etc.

attribute.name: address
attribute.description: Physical address of the item.

attribute.name: addressCountry
attribute.description: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1) format, for example "US". For backward compatibility, a 3-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) country code such as "SGP" or a full country name such as "Singapore" can also be used.

attribute.name: addressLocality
attribute.description: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Mountain View.

attribute.name: addressRegion
attribute.description: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, California or another appropriate first-level [Administrative division](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_administrative_divisions_by_country) such as the Province in Italy or Region in Germany.

attribute.name: administrationRoute
attribute.description: A route by which this drug may be administered, e.g. 'oral'.

attribute.name: advanceBookingRequirement
attribute.description: The amount of time that is required between accepting the offer and the actual usage of the resource or service.

attribute.name: adverseOutcome
attribute.description: A possible complication and/or side effect of this therapy. If it is known that an adverse outcome is serious (resulting in death, disability, or permanent damage; requiring hospitalization; or otherwise life-threatening or requiring immediate medical attention), tag it as a seriousAdverseOutcome instead.

attribute.name: affectedBy
attribute.description: Drugs that affect the test's results.

attribute.name: affiliation
attribute.description: An organization that this person is affiliated with. For example, a school/university, a club, or a team.

attribute.name: afterMedia
attribute.description: A media object representing the circumstances after performing this direction.

attribute.name: agent
attribute.description: The direct performer or driver of the action (animate or inanimate). E.g. *John* wrote a book.

attribute.name: agentInteractionStatistic
attribute.description: The number of completed interactions for this entity, in a particular role (the 'agent'), in a particular action (indicated in the statistic), and in a particular context (i.e. interactionService).

attribute.name: aggregateElement
attribute.description: Indicates a prototype of the elements in the list that is used to hold aggregate information (ratings, offers, etc.).

attribute.name: aggregateRating
attribute.description: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.
attribute.applies_to: CreativeWork, Product, Brand, Offer, Organization, Event, Place, Service

attribute.name: aircraft
attribute.description: The kind of aircraft (e.g., "Boeing 747").

attribute.name: album
attribute.description: A music album.

attribute.name: albumProductionType
attribute.description: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

attribute.name: albumRelease
attribute.description: A release of this album.

attribute.name: albumReleaseType
attribute.description: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

attribute.name: albums
attribute.description: A collection of music albums.

attribute.name: alcoholWarning
attribute.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of alcohol while taking this drug.

attribute.name: algorithm
attribute.description: The algorithm or rules to follow to compute the score.

attribute.name: alignmentType
attribute.description: A category of alignment between the learning resource and the framework node. Recommended values include: 'requires', 'textComplexity', 'readingLevel', and 'educationalSubject'.

attribute.name: alternateName
attribute.description: An alias for the item.

attribute.name: alternativeHeadline
attribute.description: A secondary title of the CreativeWork.

attribute.name: alternativeOf
attribute.description: Another gene which is a variation of this one.

attribute.name: alumni
attribute.description: Alumni of an organization.

attribute.name: alumniOf
attribute.description: An organization that the person is an alumni of.

attribute.name: amenityFeature
attribute.description: An amenity feature (e.g. a characteristic or service) of the Accommodation. This generic property does not make a statement about whether the feature is included in an offer for the main accommodation or available at extra costs.

attribute.name: amount
attribute.description: The amount of money.

attribute.name: amountOfThisGood
attribute.description: The quantity of the goods included in the offer.

attribute.name: announcementLocation
attribute.description: Indicates a specific [[CivicStructure]] or [[LocalBusiness]] associated with the SpecialAnnouncement. For example, a specific testing facility or business with special opening hours. For a larger geographic region like a quarantine of an entire region, use [[spatialCoverage]].

attribute.name: annualPercentageRate
attribute.description: The annual rate that is charged for borrowing (or made by investing), expressed as a single percentage number that represents the actual yearly cost of funds over the term of a loan. This includes any fees or additional costs associated with the transaction.

attribute.name: answerCount
attribute.description: The number of answers this question has received.

attribute.name: answerExplanation
attribute.description: A step-by-step or full explanation about Answer. Can outline how this Answer was achieved or contain more broad clarification or statement about it.

attribute.name: antagonist
attribute.description: The muscle whose action counteracts the specified muscle.

attribute.name: appearance
attribute.description: Indicates an occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

attribute.name: applicableCountry
attribute.description: A country where a particular merchant return policy applies to, for example the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

attribute.name: applicableLocation
attribute.description: The location in which the status applies.

attribute.name: applicantLocationRequirements
attribute.description: The location(s) applicants can apply from. This is usually used for telecommuting jobs where the applicant does not need to be in a physical office. Note: This should not be used for citizenship or work visa requirements.

attribute.name: application
attribute.description: An application that can complete the request.

attribute.name: applicationCategory
attribute.description: Type of software application, e.g. 'Game, Multimedia'.

attribute.name: applicationContact
attribute.description: Contact details for further information relevant to this job posting.

attribute.name: applicationDeadline
attribute.description: The date on which the program stops collecting applications for the next enrollment cycle. Flexible application deadlines (for example, a program with rolling admissions) can be described in a textual string, rather than as a DateTime.

attribute.name: applicationStartDate
attribute.description: The date at which the program begins collecting applications for the next enrollment cycle.

attribute.name: applicationSubCategory
attribute.description: Subcategory of the application, e.g. 'Arcade Game'.

attribute.name: applicationSuite
attribute.description: The name of the application suite to which the application belongs (e.g. Excel belongs to Office).

attribute.name: appliesToDeliveryMethod
attribute.description: The delivery method(s) to which the delivery charge or payment charge specification applies.

attribute.name: appliesToPaymentMethod
attribute.description: The payment method(s) to which the payment charge specification applies.

attribute.name: archiveHeld
attribute.description: Collection, [fonds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fonds), or item held, kept or maintained by an [[ArchiveOrganization]].

attribute.name: archivedAt
attribute.description: Indicates a page or other link involved in archival of a [[CreativeWork]]. In the case of [[MediaReview]], the items in a [[MediaReviewItem]] may often become inaccessible, but be archived by archival, journalistic, activist, or law enforcement organizations. In such cases, the referenced page may not directly publish the content.

attribute.name: area
attribute.description: The area within which users can expect to reach the broadcast service.

attribute.name: areaServed
attribute.description: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.
attribute.applies_to: Offer, DeliveryChargeSpecification, Demand, Organization, ContactPoint, Service, FinancialIncentive

attribute.name: arrivalAirport
attribute.description: The airport where the flight terminates.

attribute.name: arrivalBoatTerminal
attribute.description: The terminal or port from which the boat arrives.

attribute.name: arrivalBusStop
attribute.description: The stop or station from which the bus arrives.

attribute.name: arrivalGate
attribute.description: Identifier of the flight's arrival gate.

attribute.name: arrivalPlatform
attribute.description: The platform where the train arrives.

attribute.name: arrivalStation
attribute.description: The station where the train trip ends.

attribute.name: arrivalTerminal
attribute.description: Identifier of the flight's arrival terminal.

attribute.name: arrivalTime
attribute.description: The expected arrival time.

attribute.name: artEdition
attribute.description: The number of copies when multiple copies of a piece of artwork are produced - e.g. for a limited edition of 20 prints, 'artEdition' refers to the total number of copies (in this example "20").

attribute.name: artMedium
attribute.description: The material used. (E.g. Oil, Watercolour, Acrylic, Linoprint, Marble, Cyanotype, Digital, Lithograph, DryPoint, Intaglio, Pastel, Woodcut, Pencil, Mixed Media, etc.)

attribute.name: arterialBranch
attribute.description: The branches that comprise the arterial structure.

attribute.name: artform
attribute.description: e.g. Painting, Drawing, Sculpture, Print, Photograph, Assemblage, Collage, etc.

attribute.name: articleBody
attribute.description: The actual body of the article.

attribute.name: articleSection
attribute.description: Articles may belong to one or more 'sections' in a magazine or newspaper, such as Sports, Lifestyle, etc.

attribute.name: artist
attribute.description: The primary artist for a work in a medium other than pencils or digital line art--for example, if the primary artwork is done in watercolors or digital paints.

attribute.name: artworkSurface
attribute.description: The supporting materials for the artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.

attribute.name: asin
attribute.description:
An Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) is a 10-character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.com and its partners for product identification within the Amazon organization (summary from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Standard_Identification_Number)'s article).
Note also that this is a definition for how to include ASINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of ASINs in general - see documentation from Amazon for authoritative details. ASINs are most commonly encoded as text strings, but the [asin] property supports URL/URI as potential values too.

attribute.name: aspect
attribute.description: An aspect of medical practice that is considered on the page, such as 'diagnosis', 'treatment', 'causes', 'prognosis', 'etiology', 'epidemiology', etc.

attribute.name: assembly
attribute.description: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

attribute.name: assemblyVersion
attribute.description: Associated product/technology version. E.g., .NET Framework 4.5.

attribute.name: assesses
attribute.description: The item being described is intended to assess the competency or learning outcome defined by the referenced term.

attribute.name: associatedAnatomy
attribute.description: The anatomy of the underlying organ system or structures associated with this entity.

attribute.name: associatedArticle
attribute.description: A NewsArticle associated with the Media Object.

attribute.name: associatedClaimReview
attribute.description: An associated [[ClaimReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

attribute.name: associatedDisease
attribute.description: Disease associated to this BioChemEntity. Such disease can be a MedicalCondition or a URL. If you want to add an evidence supporting the association, please use PropertyValue.

attribute.name: associatedMedia
attribute.description: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for encoding.

attribute.name: associatedMediaReview
attribute.description: An associated [[MediaReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

attribute.name: associatedPathophysiology
attribute.description: If applicable, a description of the pathophysiology associated with the anatomical system, including potential abnormal changes in the mechanical, physical, and biochemical functions of the system.

attribute.name: associatedReview
attribute.description: An associated [[Review]].

attribute.name: athlete
attribute.description: A person that acts as performing member of a sports team; a player as opposed to a coach.

attribute.name: attendee
attribute.description: A person or organization attending the event.

attribute.name: attendees
attribute.description: A person attending the event.

attribute.name: audience
attribute.description: An intended audience, i.e. a group for whom something was created.
attribute.applies_to: CreativeWork, Product, Service, LodgingBusiness, Event, PlayAction

attribute.name: audienceType
attribute.description: The target group associated with a given audience (e.g. veterans, car owners, musicians, etc.).

attribute.name: audio
attribute.description: An embedded audio object.

attribute.name: auditDate
attribute.description: Date when a certification was last audited. See also [gs1:certificationAuditDate](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationAuditDate).

attribute.name: authenticator
attribute.description: The Organization responsible for authenticating the user's subscription. For example, many media apps require a cable/satellite provider to authenticate your subscription before playing media.

attribute.name: author
attribute.description: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

attribute.name: availability
attribute.description: The availability of this item—for example In stock, Out of stock, Pre-order, etc.

attribute.name: availabilityEnds
attribute.description: The end of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

attribute.name: availabilityStarts
attribute.description: The beginning of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

attribute.name: availableAtOrFrom
attribute.description: The place(s) from which the offer can be obtained (e.g. store locations).

attribute.name: availableChannel
attribute.description: A means of accessing the service (e.g. a phone bank, a web site, a location, etc.).

attribute.name: availableDeliveryMethod
attribute.description: The delivery method(s) available for this offer.

attribute.name: availableFrom
attribute.description: When the item is available for pickup from the store, locker, etc.

attribute.name: availableIn
attribute.description: The location in which the strength is available.

attribute.name: availableLanguage
attribute.description: A language someone may use with or at the item, service or place. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[inLanguage]].

attribute.name: availableOnDevice
attribute.description: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.

attribute.name: availableService
attribute.description: A medical service available from this provider.

attribute.name: availableStrength
attribute.description: An available dosage strength for the drug.

attribute.name: availableTest
attribute.description: A diagnostic test or procedure offered by this lab.

attribute.name: availableThrough
attribute.description: After this date, the item will no longer be available for pickup.

attribute.name: award
attribute.description: An award won by or for this item.

attribute.name: awards
attribute.description: Awards won by or for this item.

attribute.name: awayTeam
attribute.description: The away team in a sports event.

attribute.name: backstory
attribute.description: For an [[Article]], typically a [[NewsArticle]], the backstory property provides a textual summary giving a brief explanation of why and how an article was created. In a journalistic setting this could include information about reporting process, methods, interviews, data sources, etc.

attribute.name: bankAccountType
attribute.description: The type of a bank account.

attribute.name: baseSalary
attribute.description: The base salary of the job or of an employee in an EmployeeRole.

attribute.name: bccRecipient
attribute.description: A sub property of recipient. The recipient blind copied on a message.

attribute.name: bed
attribute.description: The type of bed or beds included in the accommodation. For the single case of just one bed of a certain type, you use bed directly with a text. If you want to indicate the quantity of a certain kind of bed, use an instance of BedDetails. For more detailed information, use the amenityFeature property.

attribute.name: beforeMedia
attribute.description: A media object representing the circumstances before performing this direction.

attribute.name: beneficiaryBank
attribute.description: A bank or bank’s branch, financial institution or international financial institution operating the beneficiary’s bank account or releasing funds for the beneficiary.

attribute.name: benefits
attribute.description: Description of benefits associated with the job.

attribute.name: benefitsSummaryUrl
attribute.description: The URL that goes directly to the summary of benefits and coverage for the specific standard plan or plan variation.

attribute.name: bestRating
attribute.description: The highest value allowed in this rating system.

attribute.name: billingAddress
attribute.description: The billing address for the order.

attribute.name: billingDuration
attribute.description: Specifies for how long this price (or price component) will be billed. Can be used, for example, to model the contractual duration of a subscription or payment plan. Type can be either a Duration or a Number (in which case the unit of measurement, for example month, is specified by the unitCode property).

attribute.name: billingIncrement
attribute.description: This property specifies the minimal quantity and rounding increment that will be the basis for the billing. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

attribute.name: billingPeriod
attribute.description: The time interval used to compute the invoice.

attribute.name: billingStart
attribute.description: Specifies after how much time this price (or price component) becomes valid and billing starts. Can be used, for example, to model a price increase after the first year of a subscription. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

attribute.name: bioChemInteraction
attribute.description: A BioChemEntity that is known to interact with this item.

attribute.name: bioChemSimilarity
attribute.description: A similar BioChemEntity, e.g., obtained by fingerprint similarity algorithms.

attribute.name: biologicalRole
attribute.description: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a biological context.

attribute.name: biomechnicalClass
attribute.description: The biomechanical properties of the bone.

attribute.name: birthDate
attribute.description: Date of birth.

attribute.name: birthPlace
attribute.description: The place where the person was born.

attribute.name: bitrate
attribute.description: The bitrate of the media object.

attribute.name: blogPost
attribute.description: A posting that is part of this blog.

attribute.name: blogPosts
attribute.description: Indicates a post that is part of a [[Blog]]. Note that historically, what we term a "Blog" was once known as a "weblog", and that what we term a "BlogPosting" is now often colloquially referred to as a "blog".

attribute.name: bloodSupply
attribute.description: The blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the muscle.

attribute.name: boardingGroup
attribute.description: The airline-specific indicator of boarding order / preference.

attribute.name: boardingPolicy
attribute.description: The type of boarding policy used by the airline (e.g. zone-based or group-based).

attribute.name: bodyLocation
attribute.description: Location in the body of the anatomical structure.

attribute.name: bodyType
attribute.description: Indicates the design and body style of the vehicle (e.g. station wagon, hatchback, etc.).

attribute.name: bookEdition
attribute.description: The edition of the book.

attribute.name: bookFormat
attribute.description: The format of the book.

attribute.name: bookingAgent
attribute.description: 'bookingAgent' is an out-dated term indicating a 'broker' that serves as a booking agent.

attribute.name: bookingTime
attribute.description: The date and time the reservation was booked.

attribute.name: borrower
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The person that borrows the object being lent.

attribute.name: box
attribute.description: A box is the area enclosed by the rectangle formed by two points. The first point is the lower corner, the second point is the upper corner. A box is expressed as two points separated by a space character.

attribute.name: branch
attribute.description: The branches that delineate from the nerve bundle. Not to be confused with [[branchOf]].

attribute.name: branchCode
attribute.description: A short textual code (also called "store code") that uniquely identifies a place of business. The code is typically assigned by the parentOrganization and used in structured URLs.\n\nFor example, in the URL http://www.starbucks.co.uk/store-locator/etc/detail/3047 the code "3047" is a branchCode for a particular branch.

attribute.name: branchOf
attribute.description: The larger organization that this local business is a branch of, if any. Not to be confused with (anatomical) [[branch]].

attribute.name: brand
attribute.description: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.

attribute.name: breadcrumb
attribute.description: A set of links that can help a user understand and navigate a website hierarchy.

attribute.name: breastfeedingWarning
attribute.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use by breastfeeding mothers.

attribute.name: broadcastAffiliateOf
attribute.description: The media network(s) whose content is broadcast on this station.

attribute.name: broadcastChannelId
attribute.description: The unique address by which the BroadcastService can be identified in a provider lineup. In US, this is typically a number.

attribute.name: broadcastDisplayName
attribute.description: The name displayed in the channel guide. For many US affiliates, it is the network name.

attribute.name: broadcastFrequency
attribute.description: The frequency used for over-the-air broadcasts. Numeric values or simple ranges, e.g. 87-99. In addition a shortcut idiom is supported for frequencies of AM and FM radio channels, e.g. "87 FM".

attribute.name: broadcastFrequencyValue
attribute.description: The frequency in MHz for a particular broadcast.

attribute.name: broadcastOfEvent
attribute.description: The event being broadcast such as a sporting event or awards ceremony.

attribute.name: broadcastServiceTier
attribute.description: The type of service required to have access to the channel (e.g. Standard or Premium).

attribute.name: broadcastSignalModulation
attribute.description: The modulation (e.g. FM, AM, etc) used by a particular broadcast service.

attribute.name: broadcastSubChannel
attribute.description: The subchannel used for the broadcast.

attribute.name: broadcastTimezone
attribute.description: The timezone in [ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) for which the service bases its broadcasts.

attribute.name: broadcaster
attribute.description: The organization owning or operating the broadcast service.

attribute.name: broker
attribute.description: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller. In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange. If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.

attribute.name: browserRequirements
attribute.description: Specifies browser requirements in human-readable text. For example, 'requires HTML5 support'.

attribute.name: busName
attribute.description: The name of the bus (e.g. Bolt Express).

attribute.name: busNumber
attribute.description: The unique identifier for the bus.

attribute.name: businessDays
attribute.description: Days of the week when the merchant typically operates, indicated via opening hours markup.

attribute.name: businessFunction
attribute.description: The business function (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose) of the offer or component of a bundle (TypeAndQuantityNode). The default is http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.

attribute.name: buyer
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The participant/person/organization that bought the object.

attribute.name: byArtist
attribute.description: The artist that performed this album or recording.

attribute.name: byDay
attribute.description: Defines the day(s) of the week on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. May be specified using either [[DayOfWeek]], or alternatively [[Text]] conforming to iCal's syntax for byDay recurrence rules.

attribute.name: byMonth
attribute.description: Defines the month(s) of the year on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-12. January is 1.

attribute.name: byMonthDay
attribute.description: Defines the day(s) of the month on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-31.

attribute.name: byMonthWeek
attribute.description: Defines the week(s) of the month on which a recurring Event takes place. Specified as an Integer between 1-5. For clarity, byMonthWeek is best used in conjunction with byDay to indicate concepts like the first and third Mondays of a month.

attribute.name: callSign
attribute.description: A [callsign](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Call_sign), as used in broadcasting and radio communications to identify people, radio and TV stations, or vehicles.

attribute.name: calories
attribute.description: The number of calories.

attribute.name: candidate
attribute.description: A sub property of object. The candidate subject of this action.

attribute.name: caption
attribute.description: The caption for this object. For downloadable machine formats (closed caption, subtitles etc.) use MediaObject and indicate the [[encodingFormat]].

attribute.name: carbohydrateContent
attribute.description: The number of grams of carbohydrates.

attribute.name: cargoVolume
attribute.description:
The available volume for cargo or luggage. For automobiles, this is usually the trunk volume.

Typical unit code(s): LTR for liters, FTQ for cubic foot/feet

Note: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

attribute.name: carrier
attribute.description: 'carrier' is an out-dated term indicating the 'provider' for parcel delivery and flights.

attribute.name: carrierRequirements
attribute.description: Specifies specific carrier(s) requirements for the application (e.g. an application may only work on a specific carrier network).

attribute.name: cashBack
attribute.description: A cardholder benefit that pays the cardholder a small percentage of their net expenditures.

attribute.name: catalog
attribute.description: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

attribute.name: catalogNumber
attribute.description: The catalog number for the release.

attribute.name: category
attribute.description: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.
attribute.applies_to: Invoice, Offer, Recommendation, Guide, ActionAccessSpecification, SpecialAnnouncement, PhysicalActivity, Product, Service

attribute.name: cause
attribute.description: The cause of a medical condition.

attribute.name: causeOf
attribute.description: The condition, complication, symptom, sign, etc. caused.

attribute.name: ccRecipient
attribute.description: A sub property of recipient. The recipient copied on a message.

attribute.name: certificationIdentification
attribute.description: Identifier of a certification instance (as registered with an independent certification body). Typically this identifier can be used to consult and verify the certification instance. See also [gs1:certificationIdentification](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationIdentification).

attribute.name: certificationRating
attribute.description: Rating of a certification instance (as defined by an independent certification body). Typically this rating can be used to rate the level to which the requirements of the certification instance are fulfilled. See also [gs1:certificationValue](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationValue).

attribute.name: certificationStatus
attribute.description: Indicates the current status of a certification: active or inactive. See also [gs1:certificationStatus](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationStatus).

attribute.name: character
attribute.description: Fictional person connected with a creative work.

attribute.name: characterAttribute
attribute.description: A piece of data that represents a particular aspect of a fictional character (skill, power, character points, advantage, disadvantage).

attribute.name: characterName
attribute.description: The name of a character played in some acting or performing role, i.e. in a PerformanceRole.

attribute.name: cheatCode
attribute.description: Cheat codes to the game.

attribute.name: checkinTime
attribute.description: The earliest someone may check into a lodging establishment.

attribute.name: checkoutPageURLTemplate
attribute.description: A URL template (RFC 6570) for a checkout page for an offer. This approach allows merchants to specify a URL for online checkout of the offered product, by interpolating parameters such as the logged in user ID, product ID, quantity, discount code etc. Parameter naming and standardization are not specified here.

attribute.name: checkoutTime
attribute.description: The latest someone may check out of a lodging establishment.

attribute.name: chemicalComposition
attribute.description: The chemical composition describes the identity and relative ratio of the chemical elements that make up the substance.

attribute.name: chemicalRole
attribute.description: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a chemical context.

attribute.name: childMaxAge
attribute.description: Maximal age of the child.

attribute.name: childMinAge
attribute.description: Minimal age of the child.

attribute.name: childTaxon
attribute.description: Closest child taxa of the taxon in question.

attribute.name: children
attribute.description: A child of the person.

attribute.name: cholesterolContent
attribute.description: The number of milligrams of cholesterol.

attribute.name: circle
attribute.description: A circle is the circular region of a specified radius centered at a specified latitude and longitude. A circle is expressed as a pair followed by a radius in meters.

attribute.name: citation
attribute.description: A citation or reference to another creative work, such as another publication, web page, scholarly article, etc.

attribute.name: claimInterpreter
attribute.description: For a [[Claim]] interpreted from [[MediaObject]] content, the [[interpretedAsClaim]] property can be used to indicate a claim contained, implied or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]].

attribute.name: claimReviewed
attribute.description: A short summary of the specific claims reviewed in a ClaimReview.

attribute.name: clincalPharmacology
attribute.description: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

attribute.name: clinicalPharmacology
attribute.description: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

attribute.name: clipNumber
attribute.description: Position of the clip within an ordered group of clips.

attribute.name: closes
attribute.description: The closing hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

attribute.name: coach
attribute.description: A person that acts in a coaching role for a sports team.

attribute.name: code
attribute.description: A medical code for the entity, taken from a controlled vocabulary or ontology such as ICD-9, DiseasesDB, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, etc.

attribute.name: codeRepository
attribute.description: Link to the repository where the un-compiled, human readable code and related code is located (SVN, GitHub, CodePlex).

attribute.name: codeSampleType
attribute.description: What type of code sample: full (compile ready) solution, code snippet, inline code, scripts, template.

attribute.name: codeValue
attribute.description: A short textual code that uniquely identifies the value.

attribute.name: codingSystem
attribute.description: The coding system, e.g. 'ICD-10'.

attribute.name: colleague
attribute.description: A colleague of the person.

attribute.name: colleagues
attribute.description: A colleague of the person.

attribute.name: collection
attribute.description: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

attribute.name: collectionSize
attribute.description: The number of items in the [[Collection]].

attribute.name: color
attribute.description: The color of the product.

attribute.name: colorSwatch
attribute.description: A color swatch image, visualizing the color of a [[Product]]. Should match the textual description specified in the [[color]] property. This can be a URL or a fully described ImageObject.

attribute.name: colorist
attribute.description: The individual who adds color to inked drawings.

attribute.name: comment
attribute.description: Comments, typically from users.

attribute.name: commentCount
attribute.description: The number of comments this CreativeWork (e.g. Article, Question or Answer) has received. This is most applicable to works published in Web sites with commenting system; additional comments may exist elsewhere.

attribute.name: commentText
attribute.description: The text of the UserComment.

attribute.name: commentTime
attribute.description: The time at which the UserComment was made.

attribute.name: companyRegistration
attribute.description: The official registration information of a business including the organization that issued it such as Company House or Chamber of Commerce in form of a Certification.

attribute.name: competencyRequired
attribute.description: Knowledge, skill, ability or personal attribute that must be demonstrated by a person or other entity in order to do something such as earn an Educational Occupational Credential or understand a LearningResource.

attribute.name: competitor
attribute.description: A competitor in a sports event.

attribute.name: composer
attribute.description: The person or organization who wrote a composition, or who is the composer of a work performed at some event.

attribute.name: comprisedOf
attribute.description: Specifying something physically contained by something else. Typically used here for the underlying anatomical structures, such as organs, that comprise the anatomical system.

attribute.name: conditionsOfAccess
attribute.description: Conditions that affect the availability of, or method(s) of access to, an item. Typically used for real world items such as an [[ArchiveComponent]] held by an [[ArchiveOrganization]]. This property is not suitable for use as a general Web access control mechanism. It is expressed only in natural language.\n\nFor example "Available by appointment from the Reading Room" or "Accessible only from logged-in accounts ".

attribute.name: confirmationNumber
attribute.description: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.

attribute.name: connectedTo
attribute.description: Other anatomical structures to which this structure is connected.

attribute.name: constraintProperty
attribute.description: Indicates a property used as a constraint. For example, in the definition of a [[StatisticalVariable]]. The value is a property, either from within Schema.org or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

attribute.name: contactOption
attribute.description: An option available on this contact point (e.g. a toll-free number or support for hearing-impaired callers).

attribute.name: contactPoint
attribute.description: A contact point for a person or organization.

attribute.name: contactPoints
attribute.description: A contact point for a person or organization.

attribute.name: contactType
attribute.description: A person or organization can have different contact points, for different purposes. For example, a sales contact point, a PR contact point and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of contact point.

attribute.name: contactlessPayment
attribute.description: A secure method for consumers to purchase products or services via debit, credit or smartcards by using RFID or NFC technology.

attribute.name: containedIn
attribute.description: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

attribute.name: containedInPlace
attribute.description: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

attribute.name: containsPlace
attribute.description: The basic containment relation between a place and another that it contains.

attribute.name: containsSeason
attribute.description: A season that is part of the media series.

attribute.name: contentLocation
attribute.description: The location depicted or described in the content. For example, the location in a photograph or painting.

attribute.name: contentRating
attribute.description: Official rating of a piece of content—for example, 'MPAA PG-13'.

attribute.name: contentReferenceTime
attribute.description: The specific time described by a creative work, for works (e.g. articles, video objects etc.) that emphasise a particular moment within an Event.

attribute.name: contentSize
attribute.description: File size in (mega/kilo)bytes.

attribute.name: contentType
attribute.description: The supported content type(s) for an EntryPoint response.

attribute.name: contentUrl
attribute.description: Actual bytes of the media object, for example the image file or video file.

attribute.name: contraindication
attribute.description: A contraindication for this therapy.

attribute.name: contributor
attribute.description: A secondary contributor to the CreativeWork or Event.

attribute.name: cookTime
attribute.description: The time it takes to actually cook the dish, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

attribute.name: cookingMethod
attribute.description: The method of cooking, such as Frying, Steaming, ...

attribute.name: copyrightHolder
attribute.description: The party holding the legal copyright to the CreativeWork.

attribute.name: copyrightNotice
attribute.description: Text of a notice appropriate for describing the copyright aspects of this Creative Work, ideally indicating the owner of the copyright for the Work.

attribute.name: copyrightYear
attribute.description: The year during which the claimed copyright for the CreativeWork was first asserted.

attribute.name: correction
attribute.description: Indicates a correction to a [[CreativeWork]], either via a [[CorrectionComment]], textually or in another document.

attribute.name: correctionsPolicy
attribute.description: For an [[Organization]] (e.g. [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement describing (in news media, the newsroom’s) disclosure and correction policy for errors.

attribute.name: costCategory
attribute.description: The category of cost, such as wholesale, retail, reimbursement cap, etc.

attribute.name: costCurrency
attribute.description: The currency (in 3-letter) of the drug cost. See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217.

attribute.name: costOrigin
attribute.description: Additional details to capture the origin of the cost data. For example, 'Medicare Part B'.

attribute.name: costPerUnit
attribute.description: The cost per unit of the drug.

attribute.name: countriesNotSupported
attribute.description: Countries for which the application is not supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

attribute.name: countriesSupported
attribute.description: Countries for which the application is supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

attribute.name: countryOfAssembly
attribute.description: The place where the product was assembled.

attribute.name: countryOfLastProcessing
attribute.description: The place where the item (typically [[Product]]) was last processed and tested before importation.

attribute.name: countryOfOrigin
attribute.description:
The country of origin of something, including products as well as creative works such as movie and TV content.
In the case of TV and movie, this would be the country of the principle offices of the production company or individual responsible for the movie. For other kinds of [[CreativeWork]] it is difficult to provide fully general guidance, and properties such as [[contentLocation]] and [[locationCreated]] may be more applicable.
In the case of products, the country of origin of the product. The exact interpretation of this may vary by context and product type, and cannot be fully enumerated here.
attribute.applies_to: CreativeWork, Product, TVSeries, TVEpisode, Movie, TVSeason

attribute.name: course
attribute.description: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

attribute.name: courseCode
attribute.description: The identifier for the [[Course]] used by the course [[provider]] (e.g. CS101 or 6.001).

attribute.name: courseMode
attribute.description: The medium or means of delivery of the course instance or the mode of study, either as a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or as a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous).

attribute.name: coursePrerequisites
attribute.description: Requirements for taking the Course. May be completion of another [[Course]] or a textual description like "permission of instructor". Requirements may be a pre-requisite competency, referenced using [[AlignmentObject]].

attribute.name: courseSchedule
attribute.description: Represents the length and pace of a course, expressed as a [[Schedule]].

attribute.name: courseWorkload
attribute.description: The amount of work expected of students taking the course, often provided as a figure per week or per month, and may be broken down by type. For example, "2 hours of lectures, 1 hour of lab work and 3 hours of independent study per week".

attribute.name: coverageEndTime
attribute.description: The time when the live blog will stop covering the Event. Note that coverage may continue after the Event concludes.

attribute.name: coverageStartTime
