attribute.description: The time when the live blog will begin covering the Event. Note that coverage may begin before the Event's start time. The LiveBlogPosting may also be created before coverage begins.

attribute.name: creativeWorkStatus
attribute.description: The status of a creative work in terms of its stage in a lifecycle. Example terms include Incomplete, Draft, Published, Obsolete. Some organizations define a set of terms for the stages of their publication lifecycle.

attribute.name: creator
attribute.description: The creator/author of this CreativeWork. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.

attribute.name: credentialCategory
attribute.description: The category or type of credential being described, for example "degree”, “certificate”, “badge”, or more specific term.

attribute.name: creditText
attribute.description: Text that can be used to credit person(s) and/or organization(s) associated with a published Creative Work.

attribute.name: creditedTo
attribute.description: The group the release is credited to if different than the byArtist. For example, Red and Blue is credited to "Stefani Germanotta Band", but by Lady Gaga.

attribute.name: cssSelector
attribute.description: A CSS selector, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

attribute.name: currenciesAccepted
attribute.description: The currency accepted.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

attribute.name: currency
attribute.description: The currency in which the monetary amount is expressed.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

attribute.name: currentExchangeRate
attribute.description: The current price of a currency.

attribute.name: customer
attribute.description: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.

attribute.name: customerRemorseReturnFees
attribute.description: The type of return fees if the product is returned due to customer remorse.

attribute.name: customerRemorseReturnLabelSource
attribute.description: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned due to customer remorse.

attribute.name: customerRemorseReturnShippingFeesAmount
attribute.description: The amount of shipping costs if a product is returned due to customer remorse. Applicable when property [[customerRemorseReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

attribute.name: cutoffTime
attribute.description: Order cutoff time allows merchants to describe the time after which they will no longer process orders received on that day. For orders processed after cutoff time, one day gets added to the delivery time estimate. This property is expected to be most typically used via the [[ShippingRateSettings]] publication pattern. The time is indicated using the ISO-8601 Time format, e.g. "23:30:00-05:00" would represent 6:30 pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) which is 5 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

attribute.name: cvdCollectionDate
attribute.description: collectiondate - Date for which patient counts are reported.

attribute.name: cvdFacilityCounty
attribute.description: Name of the County of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityId]] to identify the facility. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

attribute.name: cvdFacilityId
attribute.description: Identifier of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityCounty]] to indicate the county. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

attribute.name: cvdNumBeds
attribute.description: numbeds - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BEDS: Inpatient beds, including all staffed, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients.

attribute.name: cvdNumBedsOcc
attribute.description: numbedsocc - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient beds that are occupied.

attribute.name: cvdNumC19Died
attribute.description: numc19died - DEATHS: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who died in the hospital, ED, or any overflow location.

attribute.name: cvdNumC19HOPats
attribute.description: numc19hopats - HOSPITAL ONSET: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location with onset of suspected or confirmed COVID-19 14 or more days after hospitalization.

attribute.name: cvdNumC19HospPats
attribute.description: numc19hosppats - HOSPITALIZED: Patients currently hospitalized in an inpatient care location who have suspected or confirmed COVID-19.

attribute.name: cvdNumC19MechVentPats
attribute.description: numc19mechventpats - HOSPITALIZED and VENTILATED: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location who have suspected or confirmed COVID-19 and are on a mechanical ventilator.

attribute.name: cvdNumC19OFMechVentPats
attribute.description: numc19ofmechventpats - ED/OVERFLOW and VENTILATED: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed and on a mechanical ventilator.

attribute.name: cvdNumC19OverflowPats
attribute.description: numc19overflowpats - ED/OVERFLOW: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed.

attribute.name: cvdNumICUBeds
attribute.description: numicubeds - ICU BEDS: Total number of staffed inpatient intensive care unit (ICU) beds.

attribute.name: cvdNumICUBedsOcc
attribute.description: numicubedsocc - ICU BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient ICU beds that are occupied.

attribute.name: cvdNumTotBeds
attribute.description: numtotbeds - ALL HOSPITAL BEDS: Total number of all inpatient and outpatient beds, including all staffed, ICU, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients or outpatients.

attribute.name: cvdNumVent
attribute.description: numvent - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS: Total number of ventilators available.

attribute.name: cvdNumVentUse
attribute.description: numventuse - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS IN USE: Total number of ventilators in use.

attribute.name: data
attribute.description: Data associated with the event, like for instance a log message.

attribute.name: dataFeedElement
attribute.description: An item within a data feed. Data feeds may have many elements.

attribute.name: dataset
attribute.description: A dataset contained in this catalog.

attribute.name: datasetTimeInterval
attribute.description: The range of temporal applicability of a dataset, e.g. for a 2011 census dataset, the year 2011 (in ISO 8601 time interval format).

attribute.name: dateCreated
attribute.description: The date on which the CreativeWork was created or the item was added to a DataFeed.

attribute.name: dateDeleted
attribute.description: The datetime the item was removed from the DataFeed.

attribute.name: dateIssued
attribute.description: The date the ticket was issued.

attribute.name: dateModified
attribute.description: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.

attribute.name: datePosted
attribute.description: Publication date of an online listing.

attribute.name: datePublished
attribute.description: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

attribute.name: dateRead
attribute.description: The date/time at which the message has been read by the recipient if a single recipient exists.

attribute.name: dateReceived
attribute.description: The date/time the message was received if a single recipient exists.

attribute.name: dateSent
attribute.description: The date/time at which the message was sent.

attribute.name: dateVehicleFirstRegistered
attribute.description: The date of the first registration of the vehicle with the respective public authorities.

attribute.name: dateline
attribute.description:
A [dateline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dateline) is a brief piece of text included in news articles that describes where and when the story was written or filed though the date is often omitted. Sometimes only a placename is provided.
Structured representations of dateline-related information can also be expressed more explicitly using [[locationCreated]] (which represents where a work was created, e.g. where a news report was written). For location depicted or described in the content, use [[contentLocation]].
Dateline summaries are oriented more towards human readers than towards automated processing, and can vary substantially. Some examples: "BEIRUT, Lebanon, June 2.", "Paris, France", "December 19, 2017 11:43AM Reporting from Washington", "Beijing/Moscow", "QUEZON CITY, Philippines".

attribute.name: dayOfWeek
attribute.description: The day of the week for which these opening hours are valid.

attribute.name: deathDate
attribute.description: Date of death.

attribute.name: deathPlace
attribute.description: The place where the person died.

attribute.name: defaultValue
attribute.description: The default value of the input. For properties that expect a literal, the default is a literal value, for properties that expect an object, it's an ID reference to one of the current values.

attribute.name: deliveryAddress
attribute.description: Destination address.

attribute.name: deliveryLeadTime
attribute.description: The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup.

attribute.name: deliveryMethod
attribute.description: A sub property of instrument. The method of delivery.

attribute.name: deliveryStatus
attribute.description: New entry added as the package passes through each leg of its journey (from shipment to final delivery).

attribute.name: deliveryTime
attribute.description: The total delay between the receipt of the order and the goods reaching the final customer.

attribute.name: department
attribute.description: A relationship between an organization and a department of that organization, also described as an organization (allowing different urls, logos, opening hours). For example: a store with a pharmacy, or a bakery with a cafe.

attribute.name: departureAirport
attribute.description: The airport where the flight originates.

attribute.name: departureBoatTerminal
attribute.description: The terminal or port from which the boat departs.

attribute.name: departureBusStop
attribute.description: The stop or station from which the bus departs.

attribute.name: departureGate
attribute.description: Identifier of the flight's departure gate.

attribute.name: departurePlatform
attribute.description: The platform from which the train departs.

attribute.name: departureStation
attribute.description: The station from which the train departs.

attribute.name: departureTerminal
attribute.description: Identifier of the flight's departure terminal.

attribute.name: departureTime
attribute.description: The expected departure time.

attribute.name: dependencies
attribute.description: Prerequisites needed to fulfill steps in article.

attribute.name: depth
attribute.description: The depth of the item.

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: A description of the item.

attribute.name: device
attribute.description: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.

attribute.name: diagnosis
attribute.description: One or more alternative conditions considered in the differential diagnosis process as output of a diagnosis process.

attribute.name: diagram
attribute.description: An image containing a diagram that illustrates the structure and/or its component substructures and/or connections with other structures.

attribute.name: diet
attribute.description: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

attribute.name: dietFeatures
attribute.description: Nutritional information specific to the dietary plan. May include dietary recommendations on what foods to avoid, what foods to consume, and specific alterations/deviations from the USDA or other regulatory body's approved dietary guidelines.

attribute.name: differentialDiagnosis
attribute.description: One of a set of differential diagnoses for the condition. Specifically, a closely-related or competing diagnosis typically considered later in the cognitive process whereby this medical condition is distinguished from others most likely responsible for a similar collection of signs and symptoms to reach the most parsimonious diagnosis or diagnoses in a patient.

attribute.name: digitalSourceType
attribute.description: Indicates an IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration code indicating the nature of the digital source(s) for some [[CreativeWork]].

attribute.name: directApply
attribute.description: Indicates whether an [[url]] that is associated with a [[JobPosting]] enables direct application for the job, via the posting website. A job posting is considered to have directApply of [[True]] if an application process for the specified job can be directly initiated via the url(s) given (noting that e.g. multiple internet domains might nevertheless be involved at an implementation level). A value of [[False]] is appropriate if there is no clear path to applying directly online for the specified job, navigating directly from the JobPosting url(s) supplied.

attribute.name: director
attribute.description: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video gaming etc. content, or of an event. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.
attribute.applies_to: Event, VideoObject, RadioSeries, TVSeries, VideoGame, Episode, Clip, Movie, CreativeWorkSeason, MovieSeries, VideoGameSeries

attribute.name: directors
attribute.description: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video games etc. content. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.
attribute.applies_to: VideoObject, VideoGame, Episode, Clip, Movie, MovieSeries, VideoGameSeries, RadioSeries, TVSeries

attribute.name: disambiguatingDescription
attribute.description: A sub property of description. A short description of the item used to disambiguate from other, similar items. Information from other properties (in particular, name) may be necessary for the description to be useful for disambiguation.

attribute.name: discount
attribute.description: Any discount applied (to an Order).

attribute.name: discountCode
attribute.description: Code used to redeem a discount.

attribute.name: discountCurrency
attribute.description: The currency of the discount.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

attribute.name: discusses
attribute.description: Specifies the CreativeWork associated with the UserComment.

attribute.name: discussionUrl
attribute.description: A link to the page containing the comments of the CreativeWork.

attribute.name: diseasePreventionInfo
attribute.description: Information about disease prevention.

attribute.name: diseaseSpreadStatistics
attribute.description: Statistical information about the spread of a disease, either as [[WebContent]], or described directly as a [[Dataset]], or the specific [[Observation]]s in the dataset. When a [[WebContent]] URL is provided, the page indicated might also contain more such markup.

attribute.name: displayLocation
attribute.description: The location at which an item can be viewed or experienced in-person.

attribute.name: dissolutionDate
attribute.description: The date that this organization was dissolved.

attribute.name: distance
attribute.description: The distance travelled, e.g. exercising or travelling.

attribute.name: distinguishingSign
attribute.description: One of a set of signs and symptoms that can be used to distinguish this diagnosis from others in the differential diagnosis.

attribute.name: distribution
attribute.description: A downloadable form of this dataset, at a specific location, in a specific format. This property can be repeated if different variations are available. There is no expectation that different downloadable distributions must contain exactly equivalent information (see also [DCAT](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/#Class:Distribution) on this point). Different distributions might include or exclude different subsets of the entire dataset, for example.

attribute.name: diversityPolicy
attribute.description: Statement on diversity policy by an [[Organization]] e.g. a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]. For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement describing the newsroom’s diversity policy on both staffing and sources, typically providing staffing data.

attribute.name: diversityStaffingReport
attribute.description: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a report on staffing diversity issues. In a news context this might be for example ASNE or RTDNA (US) reports, or self-reported.

attribute.name: documentation
attribute.description: Further documentation describing the Web API in more detail.

attribute.name: doesNotShip
attribute.description: Indicates when shipping to a particular [[shippingDestination]] is not available.

attribute.name: domainIncludes
attribute.description: Relates a property to a class that is (one of) the type(s) the property is expected to be used on.

attribute.name: domiciledMortgage
attribute.description: Whether borrower is a resident of the jurisdiction where the property is located.

attribute.name: doorTime
attribute.description: The time admission will commence.

attribute.name: dosageForm
attribute.description: A dosage form in which this drug/supplement is available, e.g. 'tablet', 'suspension', 'injection'.

attribute.name: doseSchedule
attribute.description: A dosing schedule for the drug for a given population, either observed, recommended, or maximum dose based on the type used.

attribute.name: doseUnit
attribute.description: The unit of the dose, e.g. 'mg'.

attribute.name: doseValue
attribute.description: The value of the dose, e.g. 500.

attribute.name: downPayment
attribute.description: a type of payment made in cash during the onset of the purchase of an expensive good/service. The payment typically represents only a percentage of the full purchase price.

attribute.name: downloadUrl
attribute.description: If the file can be downloaded, URL to download the binary.

attribute.name: downvoteCount
attribute.description: The number of downvotes this question, answer or comment has received from the community.

attribute.name: drainsTo
attribute.description: The vasculature that the vein drains into.

attribute.name: driveWheelConfiguration
attribute.description: The drive wheel configuration, i.e. which roadwheels will receive torque from the vehicle's engine via the drivetrain.

attribute.name: dropoffLocation
attribute.description: Where a rental car can be dropped off.

attribute.name: dropoffTime
attribute.description: When a rental car can be dropped off.

attribute.name: drug
attribute.description: Specifying a drug or medicine used in a medication procedure.

attribute.name: drugClass
attribute.description: The class of drug this belongs to (e.g., statins).

attribute.name: drugUnit
attribute.description: The unit in which the drug is measured, e.g. '5 mg tablet'.

attribute.name: duns
attribute.description: The Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for identifying an organization or business person.

attribute.name: duplicateTherapy
attribute.description: A therapy that duplicates or overlaps this one.

attribute.name: duration
attribute.description: The duration of the item (movie, audio recording, event, etc.) in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).
attribute.applies_to: MediaObject, MusicRelease, Audiobook, Episode, Movie, QuantitativeValueDistribution, Schedule, MusicRecording, ServicePeriod, Event

attribute.name: durationOfWarranty
attribute.description: The duration of the warranty promise. Common unitCode values are ANN for year, MON for months, or DAY for days.

attribute.name: duringMedia
attribute.description: A media object representing the circumstances while performing this direction.

attribute.name: earlyPrepaymentPenalty
attribute.description: The amount to be paid as a penalty in the event of early payment of the loan.

attribute.name: editEIDR
attribute.description:
An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing a specific edit / edition for a work of film or television.
For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" whose [[titleEIDR]] is "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J" has several edits, e.g. "10.5240/1F2A-E1C5-680A-14C6-E76B-I" and "10.5240/8A35-3BEE-6497-5D12-9E4F-3".
Since schema.org types like [[Movie]] and [[TVEpisode]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possible to use [[titleEIDR]] alone (for a general description), or alongside [[editEIDR]] for a more edit-specific description.

attribute.name: editor
attribute.description: Specifies the Person who edited the CreativeWork.

attribute.name: eduQuestionType
attribute.description: For questions that are part of learning resources (e.g. Quiz), eduQuestionType indicates the format of question being given. Example: "Multiple choice", "Open ended", "Flashcard".

attribute.name: educationRequirements
attribute.description: Educational background needed for the position or Occupation.

attribute.name: educationalAlignment
attribute.description:
An alignment to an established educational framework.
This property should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

attribute.name: educationalCredentialAwarded
attribute.description: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other educational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

attribute.name: educationalFramework
attribute.description: The framework to which the resource being described is aligned.

attribute.name: educationalLevel
attribute.description: The level in terms of progression through an educational or training context. Examples of educational levels include 'beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced', and formal sets of level indicators.

attribute.name: educationalProgramMode
attribute.description: Similar to courseMode, the medium or means of delivery of the program as a whole. The value may either be a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous ).

attribute.name: educationalRole
attribute.description: An educationalRole of an EducationalAudience.

attribute.name: educationalUse
attribute.description: The purpose of a work in the context of education; for example, 'assignment', 'group work'.

attribute.name: elevation
attribute.description: The elevation of a location ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)). Values may be of the form 'NUMBER UNIT\_OF\_MEASUREMENT' (e.g., '1,000 m', '3,200 ft') while numbers alone should be assumed to be a value in meters.

attribute.name: eligibilityToWorkRequirement
attribute.description: The legal requirements such as citizenship, visa and other documentation required for an applicant to this job.

attribute.name: eligibleCustomerType
attribute.description: The type(s) of customers for which the given offer is valid.

attribute.name: eligibleDuration
attribute.description: The duration for which the given offer is valid.

attribute.name: eligibleQuantity
attribute.description: The interval and unit of measurement of ordering quantities for which the offer or price specification is valid. This allows e.g. specifying that a certain freight charge is valid only for a certain quantity.

attribute.name: eligibleRegion
attribute.description: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is valid.\n\nSee also [[ineligibleRegion]].

attribute.name: eligibleTransactionVolume
attribute.description: The transaction volume, in a monetary unit, for which the offer or price specification is valid, e.g. for indicating a minimal purchasing volume, to express free shipping above a certain order volume, or to limit the acceptance of credit cards to purchases to a certain minimal amount.

attribute.name: eligibleWithSupplier
attribute.description: The supplier of the incentivized item/service for which the incentive is valid for such as a utility company, merchant, or contractor.

attribute.name: email
attribute.description: Email address.

attribute.name: embedUrl
attribute.description: A URL pointing to a player for a specific video. In general, this is the information in the ```src``` element of an ```embed``` tag and should not be the same as the content of the ```loc``` tag.

attribute.name: embeddedTextCaption
attribute.description: Represents textual captioning from a [[MediaObject]], e.g. text of a 'meme'.

attribute.name: emissionsCO2
attribute.description: The CO2 emissions in g/km. When used in combination with a QuantitativeValue, put "g/km" into the unitText property of that value, since there is no UN/CEFACT Common Code for "g/km".

attribute.name: employee
attribute.description: Someone working for this organization.

attribute.name: employees
attribute.description: People working for this organization.

attribute.name: employerOverview
attribute.description: A description of the employer, career opportunities and work environment for this position.

attribute.name: employmentType
attribute.description: Type of employment (e.g. full-time, part-time, contract, temporary, seasonal, internship).

attribute.name: employmentUnit
attribute.description: Indicates the department, unit and/or facility where the employee reports and/or in which the job is to be performed.

attribute.name: encodesBioChemEntity
attribute.description: Another BioChemEntity encoded by this one.

attribute.name: encodesCreativeWork
attribute.description: The CreativeWork encoded by this media object.

attribute.name: encoding
attribute.description: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for associatedMedia.

attribute.name: encodingFormat
attribute.description:
Media type typically expressed using a MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml) and [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/MIME_types)), e.g. application/zip for a SoftwareApplication binary, audio/mpeg for .mp3 etc.
In cases where a [[CreativeWork]] has several media type representations, [[encoding]] can be used to indicate each [[MediaObject]] alongside particular [[encodingFormat]] information.
Unregistered or niche encoding and file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia/Wikidata entry.

attribute.name: encodingType
attribute.description: The supported encoding type(s) for an EntryPoint request.

attribute.name: encodings
attribute.description: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork.

attribute.name: endDate
attribute.description: The end date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).
attribute.applies_to: EducationalOccupationalProgram, MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride, Schedule, CreativeWorkSeason, Role, Event, CreativeWorkSeries, DatedMoneySpecification

attribute.name: endOffset
attribute.description: The end time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

attribute.name: endTime
attribute.description: The endTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to end. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from January to *December*. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the end of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified in future revisions.

attribute.name: endorsee
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The person/organization being supported.

attribute.name: endorsers
attribute.description: People or organizations that endorse the plan.

attribute.name: energyEfficiencyScaleMax
attribute.description: Specifies the most energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

attribute.name: energyEfficiencyScaleMin
attribute.description: Specifies the least energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

attribute.name: engineDisplacement
attribute.description:
The volume swept by all of the pistons inside the cylinders of an internal combustion engine in a single movement. 

Typical unit code(s): CMQ for cubic centimeter, LTR for liters, INQ for cubic inches
* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

attribute.name: enginePower
attribute.description:
The power of the vehicle's engine. Typical unit code(s): KWT for kilowatt, BHP for brake horsepower, N12 for metric horsepower (PS, with 1 PS = 735,49875 W)

* Note 1: There are many different ways of measuring an engine's power. For an overview, see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine\_power\_test\_codes](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine_power_test_codes).
* Note 2: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 3: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

attribute.name: engineType
attribute.description: The type of engine or engines powering the vehicle.

attribute.name: entertainmentBusiness
attribute.description: A sub property of location. The entertainment business where the action occurred.

attribute.name: epidemiology
attribute.description: The characteristics of associated patients, such as age, gender, race etc.

attribute.name: episode
attribute.description: An episode of a TV, radio or game media within a series or season.

attribute.name: episodeNumber
attribute.description: Position of the episode within an ordered group of episodes.

attribute.name: episodes
attribute.description: An episode of a TV/radio series or season.

attribute.name: equal
attribute.description: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is equal to the object.

attribute.name: error
attribute.description: For failed actions, more information on the cause of the failure. Consider using the Error type.

attribute.name: errorCode
attribute.description: Application or platform dependant error code.

attribute.name: estimatedCost
attribute.description: The estimated cost of the supply or supplies consumed when performing instructions.

attribute.name: estimatedFlightDuration
attribute.description: The estimated time the flight will take.

attribute.name: estimatedSalary
attribute.description: An estimated salary for a job posting or occupation, based on a variety of variables including, but not limited to industry, job title, and location. Estimated salaries are often computed by outside organizations rather than the hiring organization, who may not have committed to the estimated value.

attribute.name: estimatesRiskOf
attribute.description: The condition, complication, or symptom whose risk is being estimated.

attribute.name: ethicsPolicy
attribute.description: Statement about ethics policy, e.g. of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] regarding journalistic and publishing practices, or of a [[Restaurant]], a page describing food source policies. In the case of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], an ethicsPolicy is typically a statement describing the personal, organizational, and corporate standards of behavior expected by the organization.

attribute.name: event
attribute.description: Upcoming or past event associated with this place, organization, or action.
attribute.applies_to: InformAction, JoinAction, LeaveAction, Organization, PlayAction, Place, InviteAction

attribute.name: eventAttendanceMode
attribute.description: The eventAttendanceMode of an event indicates whether it occurs online, offline, or a mix.

attribute.name: eventSchedule
attribute.description: Associates an [[Event]] with a [[Schedule]]. There are circumstances where it is preferable to share a schedule for a series of repeating events rather than data on the individual events themselves. For example, a website or application might prefer to publish a schedule for a weekly gym class rather than provide data on every event. A schedule could be processed by applications to add forthcoming events to a calendar. An [[Event]] that is associated with a [[Schedule]] using this property should not have [[startDate]] or [[endDate]] properties. These are instead defined within the associated [[Schedule]], this avoids any ambiguity for clients using the data. The property might have repeated values to specify different schedules, e.g. for different months or seasons.

attribute.name: eventStatus
attribute.description: An eventStatus of an event represents its status; particularly useful when an event is cancelled or rescheduled.

attribute.name: events
attribute.description: Upcoming or past events associated with this place or organization.

attribute.name: evidenceLevel
attribute.description: Strength of evidence of the data used to formulate the guideline (enumerated).

attribute.name: evidenceOrigin
attribute.description: Source of the data used to formulate the guidance, e.g. RCT, consensus opinion, etc.

attribute.name: exampleOfWork
attribute.description: A creative work that this work is an example/instance/realization/derivation of.

attribute.name: exceptDate
attribute.description: Defines a [[Date]] or [[DateTime]] during which a scheduled [[Event]] will not take place. The property allows exceptions to a [[Schedule]] to be specified. If an exception is specified as a [[DateTime]] then only the event that would have started at that specific date and time should be excluded from the schedule. If an exception is specified as a [[Date]] then any event that is scheduled for that 24 hour period should be excluded from the schedule. This allows a whole day to be excluded from the schedule without having to itemise every scheduled event.

attribute.name: exchangeRateSpread
attribute.description: The difference between the price at which a broker or other intermediary buys and sells foreign currency.

attribute.name: executableLibraryName
attribute.description: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

attribute.name: exerciseCourse
attribute.description: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

attribute.name: exercisePlan
attribute.description: A sub property of instrument. The exercise plan used on this action.

attribute.name: exerciseRelatedDiet
attribute.description: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

attribute.name: exerciseType
attribute.description: Type(s) of exercise or activity, such as strength training, flexibility training, aerobics, cardiac rehabilitation, etc.

attribute.name: exifData
attribute.description: exif data for this object.

attribute.name: expectedArrivalFrom
attribute.description: The earliest date the package may arrive.

attribute.name: expectedArrivalUntil
attribute.description: The latest date the package may arrive.

attribute.name: expectedPrognosis
attribute.description: The likely outcome in either the short term or long term of the medical condition.

attribute.name: expectsAcceptanceOf
attribute.description: An Offer which must be accepted before the user can perform the Action. For example, the user may need to buy a movie before being able to watch it.

attribute.name: experienceInPlaceOfEducation
attribute.description: Indicates whether a [[JobPosting]] will accept experience (as indicated by [[OccupationalExperienceRequirements]]) in place of its formal educational qualifications (as indicated by [[educationRequirements]]). If true, indicates that satisfying one of these requirements is sufficient.

attribute.name: experienceRequirements
attribute.description: Description of skills and experience needed for the position or Occupation.

attribute.name: expertConsiderations
attribute.description: Medical expert advice related to the plan.

attribute.name: expires
attribute.description: Date the content expires and is no longer useful or available. For example a [[VideoObject]] or [[NewsArticle]] whose availability or relevance is time-limited, a [[ClaimReview]] fact check whose publisher wants to indicate that it may no longer be relevant (or helpful to highlight) after some date, or a [[Certification]] the validity has expired.

attribute.name: expressedIn
attribute.description: Tissue, organ, biological sample, etc in which activity of this gene has been observed experimentally. For example brain, digestive system.

attribute.name: extendedAddress
attribute.description: An address extension such as an apartment number, C/O or alternative name.

attribute.name: familyName
attribute.description: Family name. In the U.S., the last name of a Person.

attribute.name: fatContent
attribute.description: The number of grams of fat.

attribute.name: faxNumber

attribute.name: featureList

attribute.name: feesAndCommissionsSpecification

attribute.name: fiberContent
attribute.description: The number of grams of fiber.

attribute.name: fileFormat
attribute.description: Media type, typically MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml)) of the content, e.g. application/zip of a SoftwareApplication binary. In cases where a CreativeWork has several media type representations, 'encoding' can be used to indicate each MediaObject alongside particular fileFormat information. Unregistered or niche file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia entry.

attribute.name: fileSize
attribute.description: Size of the application / package (e.g. 18MB). In the absence of a unit (MB, KB etc.), KB will be assumed.

attribute.name: financialAidEligible

attribute.name: flightNumber

attribute.name: floorLevel
attribute.description: The floor level for an [[Accommodation]] in a multi-storey building. Since counting systems [vary internationally](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Storey#Consecutive_number_floor_designations), the local system should be used where possible.

attribute.name: floorLimit
attribute.description: A floor limit is the amount of money above which credit card transactions must be authorized.

attribute.name: floorSize
attribute.description: The size of the accommodation, e.g. in square meter or squarefoot. Typical unit code(s): MTK for square meter, FTK for square foot, or YDK for square yard.

attribute.name: followee

attribute.name: follows

attribute.name: foodEstablishment

attribute.name: foodEvent
attribute.description: A sub property of location. The specific food event where the action occurred.

attribute.name: foodWarning

attribute.name: founder

attribute.name: foundingLocation

attribute.name: free

attribute.name: freeShippingThreshold
attribute.description: A monetary value above (or at) which the shipping rate becomes free. Intended to be used via an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with [[shippingSettingsLink]] matching this [[ShippingRateSettings]].

attribute.name: fromLocation

attribute.name: fuelCapacity
attribute.description: The capacity of the fuel tank or in the case of electric cars, the battery. If there are multiple components for storage, this should indicate the total of all storage of the same type.\n\nTypical unit code(s): LTR for liters, GLL of US gallons, GLI for UK / imperial gallons, AMH for ampere-hours (for electrical vehicles).

attribute.name: fuelConsumption
attribute.description:
The amount of fuel consumed for traveling a particular distance or temporal duration with the given vehicle (e.g. liters per 100 km).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for liters per 100 km. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. L/100 km.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel consumption to another value.

attribute.name: fuelEfficiency
attribute.description:
The distance traveled per unit of fuel used; most commonly miles per gallon (mpg) or kilometers per liter (km/L).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for miles per gallon or kilometers per liter. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. mpg or km/L.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel economy to another value.

attribute.name: fuelType
attribute.description: The type of fuel suitable for the engine or engines of the vehicle. If the vehicle has only one engine, this property can be attached directly to the vehicle.

attribute.name: fulfillmentType
attribute.description: Type of fulfillment applicable to the [[ShippingService]].

attribute.name: functionalClass

attribute.name: fundedItem

attribute.name: gender
attribute.description: Gender of something, typically a [[Person]], but possibly also fictional characters, animals, etc. While https://schema.org/Male and https://schema.org/Female may be used, text strings are also acceptable for people who are not a binary gender. The [[gender]] property can also be used in an extended sense to cover e.g. the gender of sports teams. As with the gender of individuals, we do not try to enumerate all possibilities. A mixed-gender [[SportsTeam]] can be indicated with a text value of "Mixed".

attribute.name: genre
attribute.description: Genre of the creative work, broadcast channel or group.

attribute.name: geo
attribute.description: The geo coordinates of the place.

attribute.name: geoContains
attribute.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a containing geometry to a contained geometry. "a contains b iff no points of b lie in the exterior of a, and at least one point of the interior of b lies in the interior of a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

attribute.name: geoCoveredBy
attribute.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that covers it. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

attribute.name: geoCovers
attribute.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a covering geometry to a covered geometry. "Every point of b is a point of (the interior or boundary of) a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

attribute.name: geoCrosses
attribute.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that crosses it: "a crosses b: they have some but not all interior points in common, and the dimension of the intersection is less than that of at least one of them". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

attribute.name: geoDisjoint
attribute.description: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically disjoint: "they have no point in common. They form a set of disconnected geometries." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

attribute.name: geoEquals
attribute.description: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically equal, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM). "Two geometries are topologically equal if their interiors intersect and no part of the interior or boundary of one geometry intersects the exterior of the other" (a symmetric relationship).

attribute.name: geoIntersects
attribute.description: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) have at least one point in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

attribute.name: geoMidpoint
attribute.description: Indicates the GeoCoordinates at the centre of a GeoShape, e.g. GeoCircle.

attribute.name: geoOverlaps
attribute.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that geospatially overlaps it, i.e. they have some but not all points in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

attribute.name: geoRadius
attribute.description: Indicates the approximate radius of a GeoCircle (metres unless indicated otherwise via Distance notation).

attribute.name: geoTouches
attribute.description: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) touch: "they have at least one boundary point in common, but no interior points." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

attribute.name: geoWithin
attribute.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to one that contains it, i.e. it is inside (i.e. within) its interior. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

attribute.name: greater

attribute.name: greaterOrEqual

attribute.name: gtin
attribute.description:
A Global Trade Item Number ([GTIN](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin)). GTINs identify trade items, including products and services, using numeric identification codes.
A correct [[gtin]] value should be a valid GTIN, which means that it should be an all-numeric string of either 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, or a "GS1 Digital Link" URL based on such a string. The numeric component should also have a [valid GS1 check digit](https://www.gs1.org/services/check-digit-calculator) and meet the other rules for valid GTINs. See also [GS1's GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Global_Trade_Item_Number) for more details. Left-padding of the gtin values is not required or encouraged. The [[gtin]] property generalizes the earlier [[gtin8]], [[gtin12]], [[gtin13]], and [[gtin14]] properties.
The GS1 [digital link specifications](https://www.gs1.org/standards/Digital-Link/) expresses GTINs as URLs (URIs, IRIs, etc.). Digital Links should be populated into the [[hasGS1DigitalLink]] attribute.
Note also that this is a definition for how to include GTINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of GTINs in general - see the GS1 documentation for authoritative details.

attribute.name: gtin12
attribute.description: The GTIN-12 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. The GTIN-12 is the 12-digit GS1 Identification Key composed of a U.P.C. Company Prefix, Item Reference, and Check Digit used to identify trade items. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

attribute.name: gtin13
attribute.description: The GTIN-13 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This is equivalent to 13-digit ISBN codes and EAN UCC-13. Former 12-digit UPC codes can be converted into a GTIN-13 code by simply adding a preceding zero. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

attribute.name: gtin14
attribute.description: The GTIN-14 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

attribute.name: gtin8
attribute.description: The GTIN-8 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This code is also known as EAN/UCC-8 or 8-digit EAN. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

attribute.name: guidelineSubject

attribute.name: handlingTime
attribute.description:
The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup.
In the context of [[ShippingDeliveryTime]], Typical properties: minValue, maxValue, unitCode (d for DAY). This is by common convention assumed to mean business days (if a unitCode is used, coded as "d"), i.e. only counting days when the business normally operates.
In the context of [[ShippingService]], use the [[ServicePeriod]] format, that contains the same information in a structured form, with cut-off time, business days and duration.

In the case of [[CovidTestingFacility]] such facilities could potentially help with social distancing from other potentially-infected users.

attribute.name: hasEnergyConsumptionDetails

attribute.name: hasEnergyEfficiencyCategory

attribute.name: hasGS1DigitalLink
attribute.description:
The GS1 digital link associated with the object. This URL should conform to the particular requirements of digital links. The link should only contain the Application Identifiers (AIs) that are relevant for the entity being annotated, for instance a [[Product]] or an [[Organization]], and for the correct granularity. In particular, for products:
  • A Digital Link that contains a serial number (AI 21) should only be present on instances of [[IndividualProduct]]
  • A Digital Link that contains a lot number (AI 10) should be annotated as [[SomeProducts]] if only products from that lot are sold, or [[IndividualProduct]] if there is only a specific product.
  • A Digital Link that contains a global model number (AI 8013) should be attached to a [[Product]] or a [[ProductModel]].
Other item types should be adapted similarly.

Usually an exact measurement, but can also be a range of measurements for adjustable products, for example belts and ski bindings.

attribute.description:
The highest price of all offers available.

* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.
