attribute.name: incentiveAmount
attribute.description:
Describes the amount that can be redeemed from this incentive.

[[QuantitativeValue]]: Use this for incentives based on price (either raw amount or percentage-based). For a raw amount example, "You can claim $2,500 - $7,500 from the total cost of installation" would be represented as the following:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", “minValue”: 2500, “maxValue”: 7500, "unitCode": "USD" }

[[QuantitativeValue]] can also be used for percentage amounts. In such cases, value is used to represent the incentive’s percentage, while maxValue represents a limit (if one exists) to that incentive. The unitCode should be 'P1' and the unitText should be '%', while valueReference should be used for holding the currency type. For example, "You can claim up to 30% of the total cost of installation, up to a maximum of $7,500" would be:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "value": 30, "unitCode": "P1", "unitText": "%", “maxValue”: 7500, “valueReference”: “USD” }

[[UnitPriceSpecification]]: Use this for incentives that are based on amounts rather than price. For example, a net metering rebate that pays $10/kWh, up to $1,000:

{ "@type": "UnitPriceSpecification", "price": 10, "priceCurrency": "USD", "referenceQuantity": 1, "unitCode": "DO3", "unitText": "kw/h", "maxPrice": 1000, "description": "$10 / kwh up to $1000"

attribute.name: incentiveCompensation
attribute.description: Description of bonus and commission compensation aspects of the job.

attribute.name: incentiveStatus
attribute.description: The status of the incentive (active, on hold, retired, etc.).

attribute.name: incentiveType
attribute.description: The type of incentive offered (tax credit/rebate, tax deduction, tax waiver, subsidies, etc.).

attribute.name: incentives
attribute.description: Description of bonus and commission compensation aspects of the job.

attribute.name: incentivizedItem
attribute.description:
The type or specific product(s) and/or service(s) being incentivized.

DefinedTermSets are used for product and service categories such as the United Nations Standard Products and Services Code:

{ "@type": "DefinedTerm", "inDefinedTermSet": "https://www.unspsc.org/", "termCode": "261315XX", "name": "Photovoltaic module" }

For a specific product or service, use the Product type:

{ "@type": "Product", "name": "Kenmore White 17" Microwave", } For multiple different incentivized items, use multiple [[DefinedTerm]] or [[Product]].

attribute.name: includedComposition
attribute.description: Smaller compositions included in this work (e.g. a movement in a symphony).

attribute.name: includedDataCatalog
attribute.description: A data catalog which contains this dataset (this property was previously 'catalog', preferred name is now 'includedInDataCatalog').

attribute.name: includedInDataCatalog
attribute.description: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

attribute.name: includedInHealthInsurancePlan
attribute.description: The insurance plans that cover this drug.

attribute.name: includedRiskFactor
attribute.description: A modifiable or non-modifiable risk factor included in the calculation, e.g. age, coexisting condition.

attribute.name: includesAttraction
attribute.description: Attraction located at destination.

attribute.name: includesHealthPlanFormulary
attribute.description: Formularies covered by this plan.

attribute.name: includesHealthPlanNetwork
attribute.description: Networks covered by this plan.

attribute.name: includesObject
attribute.description: This links to a node or nodes indicating the exact quantity of the products included in an [[Offer]] or [[ProductCollection]].

attribute.name: incomeLimit
attribute.description:
Optional. Income limit for which the incentive is applicable for.

If MonetaryAmount is specified, this should be based on annualized income (e.g. if an incentive is limited to those making <$114,000 annually):

{ "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "maxValue": 114000, "currency": "USD", } Use Text for incentives that are limited based on other criteria, for example if an incentive is only available to recipients making 120% of the median poverty income in their area.

attribute.name: increasesRiskOf
attribute.description: The condition, complication, etc. influenced by this factor.

attribute.name: industry
attribute.description: The industry associated with the job position.

attribute.name: ineligibleRegion
attribute.description: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is not valid, e.g. a region where the transaction is not allowed.\n\nSee also [[eligibleRegion]].

attribute.name: infectiousAgent
attribute.description: The actual infectious agent, such as a specific bacterium.

attribute.name: infectiousAgentClass
attribute.description: The class of infectious agent (bacteria, prion, etc.) that causes the disease.

attribute.name: ingredients
attribute.description: A single ingredient used in the recipe, e.g. sugar, flour or garlic.

attribute.name: inker
attribute.description: The individual who traces over the pencil drawings in ink after pencils are complete.

attribute.name: insertion
attribute.description: The place of attachment of a muscle, or what the muscle moves.

attribute.name: installUrl
attribute.description: URL at which the app may be installed, if different from the URL of the item.

attribute.name: instructor
attribute.description: A person assigned to instruct or provide instructional assistance for the [[CourseInstance]].

attribute.name: instrument
attribute.description: The object that helped the agent perform the action. E.g. John wrote a book with *a pen*.

attribute.name: intensity
attribute.description: Quantitative measure gauging the degree of force involved in the exercise, for example, heartbeats per minute. May include the velocity of the movement.

attribute.name: interactingDrug
attribute.description: Another drug that is known to interact with this drug in a way that impacts the effect of this drug or causes a risk to the patient. Note: disease interactions are typically captured as contraindications.

attribute.name: interactionCount
attribute.description: This property is deprecated, alongside the UserInteraction types on which it depended.

attribute.name: interactionService
attribute.description: The WebSite or SoftwareApplication where the interactions took place.

attribute.name: interactionStatistic
attribute.description: The number of interactions for the CreativeWork using the WebSite or SoftwareApplication. The most specific child type of InteractionCounter should be used.

attribute.name: interactionType
attribute.description: The Action representing the type of interaction. For up votes, +1s, etc. use [[LikeAction]]. For down votes use [[DislikeAction]]. Otherwise, use the most specific Action.

attribute.name: interactivityType
attribute.description: The predominant mode of learning supported by the learning resource. Acceptable values are 'active', 'expositive', or 'mixed'.

attribute.name: interestRate
attribute.description: The interest rate, charged or paid, applicable to the financial product. Note: This is different from the calculated annualPercentageRate.

attribute.name: interpretedAsClaim
attribute.description: Used to indicate a specific claim contained, implied, translated or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. The interpreting party can be indicated using [[claimInterpreter]].

attribute.name: inventoryLevel
attribute.description: The current approximate inventory level for the item or items.

attribute.name: inverseOf
attribute.description: Relates a property to a property that is its inverse. Inverse properties relate the same pairs of items to each other, but in reversed direction. For example, the 'alumni' and 'alumniOf' properties are inverseOf each other. Some properties don't have explicit inverses; in these situations RDFa and JSON-LD syntax for reverse properties can be used.

attribute.name: isAcceptingNewPatients
attribute.description: Whether the provider is accepting new patients.

attribute.name: isAccessibleForFree
attribute.description: A flag to signal that the item, event, or place is accessible for free.

attribute.name: isAccessoryOrSparePartFor
attribute.description: A pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is an accessory or spare part.

attribute.name: isAvailableGenerically
attribute.description: True if the drug is available in a generic form (regardless of name).

attribute.name: isBasedOn
attribute.description: A resource from which this work is derived or from which it is a modification or adaptation.

attribute.name: isBasedOnUrl
attribute.description: A resource that was used in the creation of this resource. This term can be repeated for multiple sources. For example, http://example.com/great-multiplication-intro.html.

attribute.name: isConsumableFor
attribute.description: A pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is a consumable.

attribute.name: isEncodedByBioChemEntity
attribute.description: Another BioChemEntity encoding by this one.

attribute.name: isFamilyFriendly
attribute.description: Indicates whether this content is family friendly.

attribute.name: isGift
attribute.description: Indicates whether the offer was accepted as a gift for someone other than the buyer.

attribute.name: isInvolvedInBiologicalProcess
attribute.description: Biological process this BioChemEntity is involved in; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

attribute.name: isLiveBroadcast
attribute.description: True if the broadcast is of a live event.

attribute.name: isLocatedInSubcellularLocation
attribute.description: Subcellular location where this BioChemEntity is located; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

attribute.name: isPartOf
attribute.description: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense), is part of.

attribute.name: isPartOfBioChemEntity
attribute.description: Indicates a BioChemEntity that is (in some sense) a part of this BioChemEntity.

attribute.name: isPlanForApartment
attribute.description: Indicates some accommodation that this floor plan describes.

attribute.name: isProprietary
attribute.description: True if this item's name is a proprietary/brand name (vs. generic name).

attribute.name: isRelatedTo
attribute.description: A pointer to another, somehow related product (or multiple products).

attribute.name: isResizable
attribute.description: Whether the 3DModel allows resizing. For example, room layout applications often do not allow 3DModel elements to be resized to reflect reality.

attribute.name: isSimilarTo
attribute.description: A pointer to another, functionally similar product (or multiple products).

attribute.name: isStoreOn
attribute.description: The eCommerce marketplace this online store is on.

attribute.name: isTierOf
attribute.description: The member program this tier is a part of.

attribute.name: isUnlabelledFallback
attribute.description: This can be marked 'true' to indicate that some published [[DeliveryTimeSettings]] or [[ShippingRateSettings]] are intended to apply to all [[OfferShippingDetails]] published by the same merchant, when referenced by a [[shippingSettingsLink]] in those settings. It is not meaningful to use a 'true' value for this property alongside a transitTimeLabel (for [[DeliveryTimeSettings]]) or shippingLabel (for [[ShippingRateSettings]]), since this property is for use with unlabelled settings.

attribute.name: isVariantOf
attribute.description: Indicates the kind of product that this is a variant of. In the case of [[ProductModel]], this is a pointer (from a ProductModel) to a base product from which this product is a variant. It is safe to infer that the variant inherits all product features from the base model, unless defined locally. This is not transitive. In the case of a [[ProductGroup]], the group description also serves as a template, representing a set of Products that vary on explicitly defined, specific dimensions only (so it defines both a set of variants, as well as which values distinguish amongst those variants). When used with [[ProductGroup]], this property can apply to any [[Product]] included in the group.

attribute.name: isbn
attribute.description: The ISBN of the book.

attribute.name: isicV4
attribute.description: The International Standard of Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (ISIC), Revision 4 code for a particular organization, business person, or place.

attribute.name: iso6523Code
attribute.description: An organization identifier as defined in [ISO 6523(-1)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO/IEC_6523). The identifier should be in the `XXXX:YYYYYY:ZZZ` or `XXXX:YYYYYY`format. Where `XXXX` is a 4 digit _ICD_ (International Code Designator), `YYYYYY` is an _OID_ (Organization Identifier) with all formatting characters (dots, dashes, spaces) removed with a maximal length of 35 characters, and `ZZZ` is an optional OPI (Organization Part Identifier) with a maximum length of 35 characters. The various components (ICD, OID, OPI) are joined with a colon character (ASCII `0x3a`). Note that many existing organization identifiers defined as attributes like [leiCode](https://schema.org/leiCode) (`0199`), [duns](https://schema.org/duns) (`0060`) or [GLN](https://schema.org/globalLocationNumber) (`0088`) can be expressed using ISO-6523. If possible, ISO-6523 codes should be preferred to populating [vatID](https://schema.org/vatID) or [taxID](https://schema.org/taxID), as ISO identifiers are less ambiguous.

attribute.name: isrcCode
attribute.description: The International Standard Recording Code for the recording.

attribute.name: issn
attribute.description: The International Standard Serial Number (ISSN) that identifies this serial publication. You can repeat this property to identify different formats of, or the linking ISSN (ISSN-L) for, this serial publication.

attribute.name: issueNumber
attribute.description: Identifies the issue of publication; for example, "iii" or "2".

attribute.name: issuedBy
attribute.description: The organization issuing the item, for example a [[Permit]], [[Ticket]], or [[Certification]].

attribute.name: issuedThrough
attribute.description: The service through which the permit was granted.

attribute.name: iswcCode
attribute.description: The International Standard Musical Work Code for the composition.

attribute.name: item
attribute.description: An entity represented by an entry in a list or data feed (e.g. an 'artist' in a list of 'artists').

attribute.name: itemCondition
attribute.description: A predefined value from OfferItemCondition specifying the condition of the product or service, or the products or services included in the offer. Also used for product return policies to specify the condition of products accepted for returns.

attribute.name: itemDefectReturnFees
attribute.description: The type of return fees for returns of defect products.

attribute.name: itemDefectReturnLabelSource
attribute.description: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a defect product.

attribute.name: itemDefectReturnShippingFeesAmount
attribute.description: Amount of shipping costs for defect product returns. Applicable when property [[itemDefectReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

attribute.name: itemListElement
attribute.description:
For itemListElement values, you can use simple strings (e.g. "Peter", "Paul", "Mary"), existing entities, or use ListItem.

Text values are best if the elements in the list are plain strings. Existing entities are best for a simple, unordered list of existing things in your data. ListItem is used with ordered lists when you want to provide additional context about the element in that list or when the same item might be in different places in different lists.

Note: The order of elements in your mark-up is not sufficient for indicating the order or elements. Use ListItem with a 'position' property in such cases.

attribute.name: itemListOrder
attribute.description: Type of ordering (e.g. Ascending, Descending, Unordered).

attribute.name: itemLocation
attribute.description: Current location of the item.

attribute.name: itemOffered
attribute.data_type: MenuItem | Trip | Event | CreativeWork | Product | Service | AggregateOffer
attribute.description: An item being offered (or demanded). The transactional nature of the offer or demand is documented using [[businessFunction]], e.g. sell, lease etc. While several common expected types are listed explicitly in this definition, others can be used. Using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

attribute.name: itemReviewed
attribute.description: The item that is being reviewed/rated.

attribute.name: itemShipped
attribute.description: Item(s) being shipped.

attribute.name: itinerary
attribute.description: Destination(s) ( [[Place]] ) that make up a trip. For a trip where destination order is important use [[ItemList]] to specify that order (see examples).

attribute.name: iupacName
attribute.description: Systematic method of naming chemical compounds as recommended by the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC).

attribute.name: jobBenefits
attribute.description: Description of benefits associated with the job.

attribute.name: jobDuration
attribute.description: The expected duration of an employment offer as advertised by the employer. Relevant for job postings that have a clearly defined period in mind such as seasonal work, substitutes for maternal leave or any other temporary employment.

attribute.name: jobImmediateStart
attribute.description: An indicator as to whether a position is available for an immediate start.

attribute.name: jobLocation
attribute.description: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

attribute.name: jobLocationType
attribute.description: A description of the job location (e.g. TELECOMMUTE for telecommute jobs).

attribute.name: jobStartDate
attribute.description: The date on which a successful applicant for this job would be expected to start work. Choose a specific date in the future or use the jobImmediateStart property to indicate the position is to be filled as soon as possible.

attribute.name: jobTitle
attribute.description: The job title of the person (for example, Financial Manager).

attribute.name: jurisdiction
attribute.description: Indicates a legal jurisdiction, e.g. of some legislation, or where some government service is based.

attribute.name: keywords
attribute.description: Keywords or tags used to describe some item. Multiple textual entries in a keywords list are typically delimited by commas, or by repeating the property.

attribute.name: knownVehicleDamages
attribute.description: A textual description of known damages, both repaired and unrepaired.

attribute.name: knows
attribute.description: The most generic bi-directional social/work relation.

attribute.name: knowsAbout
attribute.description: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a topic that is known about - suggesting possible expertise but not implying it. We do not distinguish skill levels here, or relate this to educational content, events, objectives or [[JobPosting]] descriptions.

attribute.name: knowsLanguage
attribute.description: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a known language. We do not distinguish skill levels or reading/writing/speaking/signing here. Use language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47).

attribute.name: labelDetails
attribute.description: Link to the drug's label details.

attribute.name: landlord
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The owner of the real estate property.

attribute.name: language
attribute.description: A sub property of instrument. The language used on this action.

attribute.name: lastReviewed
attribute.description: Date on which the content on this web page was last reviewed for accuracy and/or completeness.

attribute.name: latitude
attribute.description: The latitude of a location. For example ```37.42242``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

attribute.name: layoutImage
attribute.description: A schematic image showing the floorplan layout.

attribute.name: learningResourceType
attribute.description: The predominant type or kind characterizing the learning resource. For example, 'presentation', 'handout'.

attribute.name: leaseLength
attribute.description: Length of the lease for some [[Accommodation]], either particular to some [[Offer]] or in some cases intrinsic to the property.

attribute.name: legalAddress
attribute.description: The legal address of an organization which acts as the officially registered address used for legal and tax purposes. The legal address can be different from the place of operations of a business and other addresses can be part of an organization.

attribute.name: legalName
attribute.description: The official name of the organization, e.g. the registered company name.

attribute.name: legalRepresentative
attribute.description: One or multiple persons who represent this organization legally such as CEO or sole administrator.

attribute.name: legalStatus
attribute.description: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

attribute.name: legislationAmends
attribute.description: Another legislation that this legislation amends, introducing legal changes.

attribute.name: legislationApplies
attribute.description: Indicates that this legislation (or part of a legislation) somehow transfers another legislation in a different legislative context. This is an informative link, and it has no legal value. For legally-binding links of transposition, use the legislationTransposes property. For example an informative consolidated law of a European Union's member state "applies" the consolidated version of the European Directive implemented in it.

attribute.name: legislationChanges
attribute.description: Another legislation that this legislation changes. This encompasses the notions of amendment, replacement, correction, repeal, or other types of change. This may be a direct change (textual or non-textual amendment) or a consequential or indirect change. The property is to be used to express the existence of a change relationship between two acts rather than the existence of a consolidated version of the text that shows the result of the change. For consolidation relationships, use the legislationConsolidates property.

attribute.name: legislationCommences
attribute.description: Another legislation that this one sets into force.

attribute.name: legislationConsolidates
attribute.description: Indicates another legislation taken into account in this consolidated legislation (which is usually the product of an editorial process that revises the legislation). This property should be used multiple times to refer to both the original version or the previous consolidated version, and to the legislations making the change.

attribute.name: legislationCorrects
attribute.description: Another legislation in which this one introduces textual changes, like correction of spelling mistakes, with no legal impact (for modifications that have legal impact, use legislationAmends).

attribute.name: legislationCountersignedBy
attribute.description: The person or organization that countersigned the legislation. Depending on the legal context, a countersignature can indicate that the signed authority undertakes to assume responsibility for texts emanating from a person who is inviolable and irresponsible, (for example a King, Grand Duc or President), or that the authority is in charge of the implementation of the text.

attribute.name: legislationDate
attribute.description: The date of adoption or signature of the legislation. This is the date at which the text is officially aknowledged to be a legislation, even though it might not even be published or in force.

attribute.name: legislationDateOfApplicability
attribute.description: The date at which the Legislation becomes applicable. This can sometimes be distinct from the date of entry into force : a text may come in force today, and state it will become applicable in 3 months.

attribute.name: legislationDateVersion
attribute.description: The point-in-time at which the provided description of the legislation is valid (e.g.: when looking at the law on the 2016-04-07 (= dateVersion), I get the consolidation of 2015-04-12 of the "National Insurance Contributions Act 2015")

attribute.name: legislationEnsuresImplementationOf
attribute.description: Indicates that this Legislation ensures the implementation of another Legislation, for example by modifying national legislations so that they do not contradict to an EU regulation or decision. This implies a legal meaning. Transpositions of EU Directive should be captured with legislationTransposes.

attribute.name: legislationIdentifier
attribute.description: An identifier for the legislation. This can be either a string-based identifier, like the CELEX at EU level or the NOR in France, or a web-based, URL/URI identifier, like an ELI (European Legislation Identifier) or an URN-Lex.

attribute.name: legislationJurisdiction
attribute.description: The jurisdiction from which the legislation originates.

attribute.name: legislationLegalForce
attribute.description: Whether the legislation is currently in force, not in force, or partially in force.

attribute.name: legislationLegalValue
attribute.description: The legal value of this legislation file. The same legislation can be written in multiple files with different legal values. Typically a digitally signed PDF have a "stronger" legal value than the HTML file of the same act.

attribute.name: legislationPassedBy
attribute.description: The person or organization that originally passed or made the law: typically parliament (for primary legislation) or government (for secondary legislation). This indicates the "legal author" of the law, as opposed to its physical author.

attribute.name: legislationRepeals
attribute.description: Another legislation that this legislation repeals (cancels, abrogates).

attribute.name: legislationResponsible
attribute.description: An individual or organization that has some kind of responsibility for the legislation. Typically the ministry who is/was in charge of elaborating the legislation, or the adressee for potential questions about the legislation once it is published.

attribute.name: legislationTransposes
attribute.description: Indicates that this legislation (or part of legislation) fulfills the objectives set by another legislation, by passing appropriate implementation measures. Typically, some legislations of European Union's member states or regions transpose European Directives. This indicates a legally binding link between the 2 legislations.

attribute.name: legislationType
attribute.description: The type of the legislation. Examples of values are "law", "act", "directive", "decree", "regulation", "statutory instrument", "loi organique", "règlement grand-ducal", etc., depending on the country.

attribute.name: leiCode
attribute.description: An organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal entity as defined in ISO 17442.

attribute.name: lender
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The person that lends the object being borrowed.

attribute.name: lesser
attribute.description: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than the object.

attribute.name: lesserOrEqual
attribute.description: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than or equal to the object.

attribute.name: letterer
attribute.description: The individual who adds lettering, including speech balloons and sound effects, to artwork.

attribute.name: license
attribute.description: A license document that applies to this content, typically indicated by URL.

attribute.name: lifeEvent
attribute.description: A life event like baptism, communions, Bar Mitzvahs, Aqiqah, Namakarana, Miyamairi, burial, ....

attribute.name: line
attribute.description: A line is a point-to-point path consisting of two or more points. A line is expressed as a series of two or more point objects separated by space.

attribute.name: linkRelationship
attribute.description: Indicates the relationship type of a Web link.

attribute.name: liveBlogUpdate
attribute.description: An update to the LiveBlog.

attribute.name: loanMortgageMandateAmount
attribute.description: Amount of mortgage mandate that can be converted into a proper mortgage at a later stage.

attribute.name: loanPaymentAmount
attribute.description: The amount of money to pay in a single payment.

attribute.name: loanPaymentFrequency
attribute.description: Frequency of payments due, i.e. number of months between payments. This is defined as a frequency, i.e. the reciprocal of a period of time.

attribute.name: loanRepaymentForm
attribute.description: A form of paying back money previously borrowed from a lender. Repayment usually takes the form of periodic payments that normally include part principal plus interest in each payment.

attribute.name: loanTerm
attribute.description: The duration of the loan or credit agreement.

attribute.name: loanType
attribute.description: The type of a loan or credit.

attribute.name: location
attribute.description: The location of, for example, where an event is happening, where an organization is located, or where an action takes place.

attribute.name: locationCreated
attribute.description: The location where the CreativeWork was created, which may not be the same as the location depicted in the CreativeWork.

attribute.name: lodgingUnitDescription
attribute.description: A full description of the lodging unit.

attribute.name: lodgingUnitType
attribute.description: Textual description of the unit type (including suite vs. room, size of bed, etc.).

attribute.name: logo
attribute.description: An associated logo.
attribute.applies_to: Product, Brand, Place, Organization, Service, Certification

attribute.name: longitude
attribute.description: The longitude of a location. For example ```-122.08585``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

attribute.name: loser
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The loser of the action.

attribute.name: lowPrice
attribute.description:
The lowest price of all offers available.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

attribute.name: lyricist
attribute.description: The person who wrote the words.

attribute.name: lyrics
attribute.description: The words in the song.

attribute.name: mainContentOfPage
attribute.description: Indicates if this web page element is the main subject of the page.

attribute.name: mainEntity
attribute.description: Indicates the primary entity described in some page or other CreativeWork.

attribute.name: mainEntityOfPage
attribute.description: Indicates a page (or other CreativeWork) for which this thing is the main entity being described. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#mainEntityBackground) for details.

attribute.name: maintainer
attribute.description: A maintainer of a [[Dataset]], software package ([[SoftwareApplication]]), or other [[Project]]. A maintainer is a [[Person]] or [[Organization]] that manages contributions to, and/or publication of, some (typically complex) artifact. It is common for distributions of software and data to be based on "upstream" sources. When [[maintainer]] is applied to a specific version of something e.g. a particular version or packaging of a [[Dataset]], it is always possible that the upstream source has a different maintainer. The [[isBasedOn]] property can be used to indicate such relationships between datasets to make the different maintenance roles clear. Similarly in the case of software, a package may have dedicated maintainers working on integration into software distributions such as Ubuntu, as well as upstream maintainers of the underlying work.

attribute.name: makesOffer
attribute.description: A pointer to products or services offered by the organization or person.

attribute.name: manufacturer
attribute.description: The manufacturer of the product.

attribute.name: map
attribute.description: A URL to a map of the place.

attribute.name: mapType
attribute.description: Indicates the kind of Map, from the MapCategoryType Enumeration.

attribute.name: maps
attribute.description: A URL to a map of the place.

attribute.name: marginOfError
attribute.description: A [[marginOfError]] for an [[Observation]].

attribute.name: masthead
attribute.description: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a link to the masthead page or a page listing top editorial management.

attribute.name: material
attribute.description: A material that something is made from, e.g. leather, wool, cotton, paper.

attribute.name: materialExtent
attribute.description: The quantity of the materials being described or an expression of the physical space they occupy.

attribute.name: mathExpression
attribute.description: A mathematical expression (e.g. 'x^2-3x=0') that may be solved for a specific variable, simplified, or transformed. This can take many formats, e.g. LaTeX, Ascii-Math, or math as you would write with a keyboard.

attribute.name: maxPrice
attribute.description: The highest price if the price is a range.

attribute.name: maxValue
attribute.description: The upper value of some characteristic or property.

attribute.name: maximumAttendeeCapacity
attribute.description: The total number of individuals that may attend an event or venue.

attribute.name: maximumEnrollment
attribute.description: The maximum number of students who may be enrolled in the program.

attribute.name: maximumIntake
attribute.description: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

attribute.name: maximumPhysicalAttendeeCapacity
attribute.description: The maximum physical attendee capacity of an [[Event]] whose [[eventAttendanceMode]] is [[OfflineEventAttendanceMode]] (or the offline aspects, in the case of a [[MixedEventAttendanceMode]]).

attribute.name: maximumVirtualAttendeeCapacity
attribute.description: The maximum virtual attendee capacity of an [[Event]] whose [[eventAttendanceMode]] is [[OnlineEventAttendanceMode]] (or the online aspects, in the case of a [[MixedEventAttendanceMode]]).

attribute.name: mealService
attribute.description: Description of the meals that will be provided or available for purchase.

attribute.name: measuredProperty
attribute.description: The measuredProperty of an [[Observation]], typically via its [[StatisticalVariable]]. There are various kinds of applicable [[Property]]: a schema.org property, a property from other RDF-compatible systems, e.g. W3C RDF Data Cube, Data Commons, Wikidata, or schema.org extensions such as [GS1's](https://www.gs1.org/voc/?show=properties).

attribute.name: measurementDenominator
attribute.description: Identifies the denominator variable when an observation represents a ratio or percentage.

attribute.name: measurementMethod
attribute.description: A subproperty of [[measurementTechnique]] that can be used for specifying specific methods, in particular via [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].
attribute.applies_to: DataCatalog, StatisticalVariable, Dataset, PropertyValue, DataDownload, Observation

attribute.name: measurementQualifier
attribute.description: Provides additional qualification to an observation. For example, a GDP observation measures the Nominal value.

attribute.name: measurementTechnique
attribute.description:
A technique, method or technology used in an [[Observation]], [[StatisticalVariable]] or [[Dataset]] (or [[DataDownload]], [[DataCatalog]]), corresponding to the method used for measuring the corresponding variable(s) (for datasets, described using [[variableMeasured]]; for [[Observation]], a [[StatisticalVariable]]). Often but not necessarily each [[variableMeasured]] will have an explicit representation as (or mapping to) an property such as those defined in Schema.org, or other RDF vocabularies and "knowledge graphs". In that case the subproperty of [[variableMeasured]] called [[measuredProperty]] is applicable.
The [[measurementTechnique]] property helps when extra clarification is needed about how a [[measuredProperty]] was measured. This is oriented towards scientific and scholarly dataset publication but may have broader applicability; it is not intended as a full representation of measurement, but can often serve as a high level summary for dataset discovery.
For example, if [[variableMeasured]] is: molecule concentration, [[measurementTechnique]] could be: "mass spectrometry" or "nmr spectroscopy" or "colorimetry" or "immunofluorescence". If the [[variableMeasured]] is "depression rating", the [[measurementTechnique]] could be "Zung Scale" or "HAM-D" or "Beck Depression Inventory".
If there are several [[variableMeasured]] properties recorded for some given data object, use a [[PropertyValue]] for each [[variableMeasured]] and attach the corresponding [[meas
attribute.applies_to: DataCatalog, StatisticalVariable, Dataset, DataDownload, PropertyValue, Observation

attribute.name: mechanismOfAction
attribute.description: The specific biochemical interaction through which this drug or supplement produces its pharmacological effect.

attribute.name: mediaAuthenticityCategory
attribute.description: Indicates a MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration classification of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared).

attribute.name: mediaItemAppearance
attribute.description: In the context of a [[MediaReview]], indicates specific media item(s) that are grouped using a [[MediaReviewItem]].

attribute.name: median
attribute.description: The median value.

attribute.name: medicalAudience
attribute.description: Medical audience for page.

attribute.name: medicalSpecialty
attribute.description: A medical specialty of the provider.

attribute.name: medicineSystem
attribute.description: The system of medicine that includes this MedicalEntity, for example 'evidence-based', 'homeopathic', 'chiropractic', etc.

attribute.name: meetsEmissionStandard
attribute.description: Indicates that the vehicle meets the respective emission standard.

attribute.name: member
attribute.description: A member of an Organization or a ProgramMembership. Organizations can be members of organizations; ProgramMembership is typically for individuals.

attribute.name: memberOf
attribute.description: An Organization (or ProgramMembership) to which this Person or Organization belongs.

attribute.name: members
attribute.description: A member of this organization.

attribute.name: membershipNumber
attribute.description: A unique identifier for the membership.

attribute.name: membershipPointsEarned
attribute.description: The number of membership points earned by the member. If necessary, the unitText can be used to express the units the points are issued in. (E.g. stars, miles, etc.)

attribute.name: memoryRequirements
attribute.description: Minimum memory requirements.

attribute.name: mentions
attribute.description: Indicates that the CreativeWork contains a reference to, but is not necessarily about a concept.

attribute.name: menu
attribute.description: Either the actual menu as a structured representation, as text, or a URL of the menu.

attribute.name: menuAddOn
attribute.description: Additional menu item(s) such as a side dish of salad or side order of fries that can be added to this menu item. Additionally it can be a menu section containing allowed add-on menu items for this menu item.

attribute.name: merchant
attribute.description: 'merchant' is an out-dated term for 'seller'.

attribute.name: merchantReturnDays
attribute.description: Specifies either a fixed return date or the number of days (from the delivery date) that a product can be returned. Used when the [[returnPolicyCategory]] property is specified as [[MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow]].

attribute.name: merchantReturnLink
attribute.description: Specifies a Web page or service by URL, for product returns.

attribute.name: messageAttachment
attribute.description: A CreativeWork attached to the message.

attribute.name: mileageFromOdometer
attribute.description: The total distance travelled by the particular vehicle since its initial production, as read from its odometer.\n\nTypical unit code(s): KMT for kilometers, SMI for statute miles.

attribute.name: minPrice
attribute.description: The lowest price if the price is a range.

attribute.name: minValue
attribute.description: The lower value of some characteristic or property.

attribute.name: minimumPaymentDue
attribute.description: The minimum payment required at this time.

attribute.name: missionCoveragePrioritiesPolicy
attribute.description: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement on coverage priorities, including any public agenda or stance on issues.

attribute.name: mobileUrl
attribute.description:
The [[mobileUrl]] property is provided for specific situations in which data consumers need to determine whether one of several provided URLs is a dedicated 'mobile site'.
To discourage over-use, and reflecting intial usecases, the property is expected only on [[Product]] and [[Offer]], rather than [[Thing]]. The general trend in web technology is towards [responsive design](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Responsive_web_design) in which content can be flexibly adapted to a wide range of browsing environments. Pages and sites referenced with the long-established [[url]] property should ideally also be usable on a wide variety of devices, including mobile phones. In most cases, it would be pointless and counter productive to attempt to update all [[url]] markup to use [[mobileUrl]] for more mobile-oriented pages. The property is intended for the case when items (primarily [[Product]] and [[Offer]]) have extra URLs hosted on an additional "mobile site" alongside the main one. It should not be taken as an endorsement of this publication style.

attribute.name: model
attribute.description: The model of the product. Use with the URL of a ProductModel or a textual representation of the model identifier. The URL of the ProductModel can be from an external source. It is recommended to additionally provide strong product identifiers via the gtin8/gtin13/gtin14 and mpn properties.

attribute.name: modelDate
attribute.description: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

attribute.name: modifiedTime
attribute.description: The date and time the reservation was modified.

attribute.name: molecularFormula
attribute.description: The empirical formula is the simplest whole number ratio of all the atoms in a molecule.

attribute.name: molecularWeight
attribute.description: This is the molecular weight of the entity being described, not of the parent. Units should be included in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '12 amu' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

attribute.name: monoisotopicMolecularWeight
attribute.description: The monoisotopic mass is the sum of the masses of the atoms in a molecule using the unbound, ground-state, rest mass of the principal (most abundant) isotope for each element instead of the isotopic average mass. Please include the units in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '770.230488 g/mol' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

attribute.name: monthlyMinimumRepaymentAmount
attribute.description: The minimum payment is the lowest amount of money that one is required to pay on a credit card statement each month.

attribute.name: monthsOfExperience
attribute.description: Indicates the minimal number of months of experience required for a position.

attribute.name: mpn
attribute.description: The Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, or the product to which the offer refers.

attribute.name: multipleValues
attribute.description: Whether multiple values are allowed for the property. Default is false.

attribute.name: muscleAction
attribute.description: The movement the muscle generates.

attribute.name: musicArrangement
attribute.description: An arrangement derived from the composition.

attribute.name: musicBy
attribute.description: The composer of the soundtrack.
attribute.applies_to: VideoGameSeries, VideoObject, RadioSeries, TVSeries, VideoGame, Episode, Clip, Movie, MovieSeries

attribute.name: musicCompositionForm
attribute.description: The type of composition (e.g. overture, sonata, symphony, etc.).

attribute.name: musicGroupMember
attribute.description: A member of a music group—for example, John, Paul, George, or Ringo.

attribute.name: musicReleaseFormat
attribute.description: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

attribute.name: musicalKey
attribute.description: The key, mode, or scale this composition uses.

attribute.name: naics
attribute.description: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for a particular organization or business person.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: The name of the item.

attribute.name: namedPosition
attribute.description: A position played, performed or filled by a person or organization, as part of an organization. For example, an athlete in a SportsTeam might play in the position named 'Quarterback'.

attribute.name: nationality
attribute.description: Nationality of the person.

attribute.name: naturalProgression
attribute.description: The expected progression of the condition if it is not treated and allowed to progress naturally.

attribute.name: negativeNotes
attribute.description:
Provides negative considerations regarding something, most typically in pro/con lists for reviews (alongside [[positiveNotes]]). For symmetry
In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described. Since product descriptions tend to emphasise positive claims, it may be relatively unusual to find [[negativeNotes]] used in this way. Nevertheless for the sake of symmetry, [[negativeNotes]] can be used on [[Product]].
The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most negative is at the beginning of the list).

attribute.name: nerve
attribute.description: The underlying innervation associated with the muscle.

attribute.name: nerveMotor
attribute.description: The neurological pathway extension that involves muscle control.

attribute.name: netWorth
attribute.description: The total financial value of the person as calculated by subtracting the total value of liabilities from the total value of assets.

attribute.name: newsUpdatesAndGuidelines
attribute.description: Indicates a page with news updates and guidelines. This could often be (but is not required to be) the main page containing [[SpecialAnnouncement]] markup on a site.

attribute.name: nextItem
attribute.description: A link to the ListItem that follows the current one.

attribute.name: noBylinesPolicy
attribute.description: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement explaining when authors of articles are not named in bylines.

attribute.name: nonEqual
attribute.description: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is not equal to the object.

attribute.name: nonProprietaryName
attribute.description: The generic name of this drug or supplement.

attribute.name: nonprofitStatus
attribute.description: nonprofitStatus indicates the legal status of a non-profit organization in its primary place of business.

attribute.name: normalRange
