attribute.name: nsn
attribute.description: Indicates the [NATO stock number](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO_Stock_Number) (nsn) of a [[Product]].

attribute.name: numAdults
attribute.description: The number of adults staying in the unit.

attribute.name: numChildren
attribute.description: The number of children staying in the unit.

attribute.name: numConstraints
attribute.description: Indicates the number of constraints property values defined for a particular [[ConstraintNode]] such as [[StatisticalVariable]]. This helps applications understand if they have access to a sufficiently complete description of a [[StatisticalVariable]] or other construct that is defined using properties on template-style nodes.

attribute.name: numItems
attribute.description: Limits the number of items being shipped for which these conditions apply.

attribute.name: numTracks
attribute.description: The number of tracks in this album or playlist.

attribute.name: numberOfAccommodationUnits
attribute.description: Indicates the total (available plus unavailable) number of accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits]].

attribute.name: numberOfAirbags
attribute.description: The number or type of airbags in the vehicle.

attribute.name: numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits
attribute.description: Indicates the number of available accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAccommodationUnits]].

attribute.name: numberOfAxles
attribute.description: The number of axles.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

attribute.name: numberOfBathroomsTotal
attribute.description: The total integer number of bathrooms in some [[Accommodation]], following real estate conventions as [documented in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsTotalInteger+Field): "The simple sum of the number of bathrooms. For example for a property with two Full Bathrooms and one Half Bathroom, the Bathrooms Total Integer will be 3.". See also [[numberOfRooms]].

attribute.name: numberOfBedrooms
attribute.description: The total integer number of bedrooms in a some [[Accommodation]], [[ApartmentComplex]] or [[FloorPlan]].

attribute.name: numberOfBeds
attribute.description: The quantity of the given bed type available in the HotelRoom, Suite, House, or Apartment.

attribute.name: numberOfCredits
attribute.description: The number of credits or units awarded by a Course or required to complete an EducationalOccupationalProgram.

attribute.name: numberOfDoors
attribute.description: The number of doors.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

attribute.name: numberOfEmployees
attribute.description: The number of employees in an organization, e.g. business.

attribute.name: numberOfEpisodes
attribute.description: The number of episodes in this season or series.

attribute.name: numberOfForwardGears
attribute.description: The total number of forward gears available for the transmission system of the vehicle.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

attribute.name: numberOfFullBathrooms
attribute.description: Number of full bathrooms - The total number of full and ¾ bathrooms in an [[Accommodation]]. This corresponds to the [BathroomsFull field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsFull+Field).

attribute.name: numberOfItems
attribute.description: The number of items in an ItemList. Note that some descriptions might not fully describe all items in a list (e.g., multi-page pagination); in such cases, the numberOfItems would be for the entire list.

attribute.name: numberOfLoanPayments
attribute.description: The number of payments contractually required at origination to repay the loan. For monthly paying loans this is the number of months from the contractual first payment date to the maturity date.

attribute.name: numberOfPages
attribute.description: The number of pages in the book.

attribute.name: numberOfPartialBathrooms
attribute.description: Number of partial bathrooms - The total number of half and ¼ bathrooms in an [[Accommodation]]. This corresponds to the [BathroomsPartial field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsPartial+Field).

attribute.name: numberOfPlayers
attribute.description: Indicate how many people can play this game (minimum, maximum, or range).

attribute.name: numberOfPreviousOwners
attribute.description: The number of owners of the vehicle, including the current one.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

attribute.name: numberOfRooms
attribute.description: The number of rooms (excluding bathrooms and closets) of the accommodation or lodging business. Typical unit code(s): ROM for room or C62 for no unit. The type of room can be put in the unitText property of the QuantitativeValue.
attribute.applies_to: Suite, SingleFamilyResidence, Accommodation, FloorPlan, Apartment, House, LodgingBusiness

attribute.name: numberOfSeasons
attribute.description: The number of seasons in this series.

attribute.name: numberedPosition
attribute.description: A number associated with a role in an organization, for example, the number on an athlete's jersey.

attribute.name: nutrition
attribute.description: Nutrition information about the recipe or menu item.

attribute.name: object
attribute.description: The object upon which the action is carried out, whose state is kept intact or changed. Also known as the semantic roles patient, affected or undergoer (which change their state) or theme (which doesn't). E.g. John read *a book*.

attribute.name: observationAbout
attribute.description: The [[observationAbout]] property identifies an entity, often a [[Place]], associated with an [[Observation]].

attribute.name: observationDate
attribute.description: The observationDate of an [[Observation]].

attribute.name: observationPeriod
attribute.description: The length of time an Observation took place over. The format follows `P[0-9]*[Y|M|D|h|m|s]`. For example, P1Y is Period 1 Year, P3M is Period 3 Months, P3h is Period 3 hours.

attribute.name: occupancy
attribute.description: The allowed total occupancy for the accommodation in persons (including infants etc). For individual accommodations, this is not necessarily the legal maximum but defines the permitted usage as per the contractual agreement (e.g. a double room used by a single person). Typical unit code(s): C62 for person.

attribute.name: occupationLocation
attribute.description: The region/country for which this occupational description is appropriate. Note that educational requirements and qualifications can vary between jurisdictions.

attribute.name: occupationalCategory
attribute.description: A category describing the job, preferably using a term from a taxonomy such as [BLS O*NET-SOC](http://www.onetcenter.org/taxonomy.html), [ISCO-08](https://www.ilo.org/public/english/bureau/stat/isco/isco08/) or similar, with the property repeated for each applicable value. Ideally the taxonomy should be identified, and both the textual label and formal code for the category should be provided.\n Note: for historical reasons, any textual label and formal code provided as a literal may be assumed to be from O*NET-SOC.

attribute.name: occupationalCredentialAwarded
attribute.description: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other occupational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

attribute.name: offerCount
attribute.description: The number of offers for the product.

attribute.name: offeredBy
attribute.description: A pointer to the organization or person making the offer.

attribute.name: offers
attribute.description: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.
attribute.applies_to: CreativeWork, Product, Service, AggregateOffer, EducationalOccupationalProgram, MenuItem, Trip, Event

attribute.name: offersPrescriptionByMail
attribute.description: Whether prescriptions can be delivered by mail.

attribute.name: openingHours
attribute.description: The general opening hours for a business. Opening hours can be specified as a weekly time range, starting with days, then times per day. Multiple days can be listed with commas ',' separating each day. Day or time ranges are specified using a hyphen '-'. * Days are specified using the following two-letter combinations: ```Mo```, ```Tu```, ```We```, ```Th```, ```Fr```, ```Sa```, ```Su```. * Times are specified using 24:00 format. For example, 3pm is specified as ```15:00```, 10am as ```10:00```. * Here is an example: <time itemprop="openingHours" datetime="Tu,Th 16:00-20:00">Tuesdays and Thursdays 4-8pm</time>. * If a business is open 7 days a week, then it can be specified as <time itemprop="openingHours" datetime="Mo-Su">Monday through Sunday, all day</time>.

attribute.name: openingHoursSpecification
attribute.description: The opening hours of a certain place.

attribute.name: opens
attribute.description: The opening hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

attribute.name: operatingSystem
attribute.description: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).

attribute.name: opponent
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The opponent on this action.

attribute.name: option
attribute.description: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

attribute.name: orderDate
attribute.description: Date order was placed.

attribute.name: orderDelivery
attribute.description: The delivery of the parcel related to this order or order item.

attribute.name: orderItemNumber
attribute.description: The identifier of the order item.

attribute.name: orderItemStatus
attribute.description: The current status of the order item.

attribute.name: orderNumber
attribute.description: The identifier of the transaction.

attribute.name: orderPercentage
attribute.description: Value representing the fraction of the value of the order that is charged as shipping cost. Example: 0.10 would mean shipping rate is 10% of the total order value.

attribute.name: orderQuantity
attribute.description: The number of the item ordered. If the property is not set, assume the quantity is one.

attribute.name: orderStatus
attribute.description: The current status of the order.

attribute.name: orderValue
attribute.description: Minimum and maximum order value for which these shipping conditions are valid.

attribute.name: orderedItem
attribute.description: The item ordered.

attribute.name: organizer
attribute.description: An organizer of an Event.

attribute.name: originAddress
attribute.description: Shipper's address.

attribute.name: originalMediaContextDescription
attribute.description: Describes, in a [[MediaReview]] when dealing with [[DecontextualizedContent]], background information that can contribute to better interpretation of the [[MediaObject]].

attribute.name: originalMediaLink
attribute.description: Link to the page containing an original version of the content, or directly to an online copy of the original [[MediaObject]] content, e.g. video file.

attribute.name: originatesFrom
attribute.description: The vasculature the lymphatic structure originates, or afferents, from.

attribute.name: overdosage
attribute.description: Any information related to overdose on a drug, including signs or symptoms, treatments, contact information for emergency response.

attribute.name: ownedFrom
attribute.description: The date and time of obtaining the product.

attribute.name: ownedThrough
attribute.description: The date and time of giving up ownership on the product.

attribute.name: owner
attribute.description: A person or organization who owns this Thing.

attribute.name: ownershipFundingInfo
attribute.description: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a description of organizational ownership structure; funding and grants. In a news/media setting, this is with particular reference to editorial independence. Note that the [[funder]] is also available and can be used to make basic funder information machine-readable.

attribute.name: owns
attribute.description: Things owned by the organization or person.

attribute.name: pageEnd
attribute.description: The page on which the work ends; for example "138" or "xvi".

attribute.name: pageStart
attribute.description: The page on which the work starts; for example "135" or "xiii".

attribute.name: pagination
attribute.description: Any description of pages that is not separated into pageStart and pageEnd; for example, "1-6, 9, 55" or "10-12, 46-49".

attribute.name: parent
attribute.description: A parent of this person.

attribute.name: parentItem
attribute.description: The parent of a question, answer or item in general. Typically used for Q/A discussion threads e.g. a chain of comments with the first comment being an [[Article]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. See also [[comment]] which points from something to a comment about it.

attribute.name: parentOrganization
attribute.description: The larger organization that this organization is a [[subOrganization]] of, if any.

attribute.name: parentService
attribute.description: A broadcast service to which the broadcast service may belong to such as regional variations of a national channel.

attribute.name: parentTaxon
attribute.description: Closest parent taxon of the taxon in question.

attribute.name: parents
attribute.description: A parents of the person.

attribute.name: partOfEpisode
attribute.description: The episode to which this clip belongs.

attribute.name: partOfInvoice
attribute.description: The order is being paid as part of the referenced Invoice.

attribute.name: partOfOrder
attribute.description: The overall order the items in this delivery were included in.

attribute.name: partOfSeason
attribute.description: The season to which this episode belongs.

attribute.name: partOfSeries
attribute.description: The series to which this episode or season belongs.

attribute.name: partOfSystem
attribute.description: The anatomical or organ system that this structure is part of.

attribute.name: partOfTVSeries
attribute.description: The TV series to which this episode or season belongs.

attribute.name: partOfTrip
attribute.description: Identifies that this [[Trip]] is a subTrip of another Trip. For example Day 1, Day 2, etc. of a multi-day trip.

attribute.name: participant
attribute.description: Other co-agents that participated in the action indirectly. E.g. John wrote a book with *Steve*.

attribute.name: partySize
attribute.description: Number of people the reservation should accommodate.

attribute.name: passengerPriorityStatus
attribute.description: The priority status assigned to a passenger for security or boarding (e.g. FastTrack or Priority).

attribute.name: passengerSequenceNumber
attribute.description: The passenger's sequence number as assigned by the airline.

attribute.name: pathophysiology
attribute.description: Changes in the normal mechanical, physical, and biochemical functions that are associated with this activity or condition.

attribute.name: pattern
attribute.description: A pattern that something has, for example 'polka dot', 'striped', 'Canadian flag'. Values are typically expressed as text, although links to controlled value schemes are also supported.

attribute.name: payload
attribute.description:
The permitted weight of passengers and cargo, EXCLUDING the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: Many databases specify the permitted TOTAL weight instead, which is the sum of [[weight]] and [[payload]]
* Note 2: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 3: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 4: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

attribute.name: paymentAccepted
attribute.description: Cash, Credit Card, Cryptocurrency, Local Exchange Tradings System, etc.

attribute.name: paymentDue
attribute.description: The date that payment is due.

attribute.name: paymentDueDate
attribute.description: The date that payment is due.

attribute.name: paymentMethod
attribute.description: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.

attribute.name: paymentMethodId
attribute.description: An identifier for the method of payment used (e.g. the last 4 digits of the credit card).

attribute.name: paymentMethodType
attribute.description: The type of a payment method.

attribute.name: paymentStatus
attribute.description: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.

attribute.name: paymentUrl
attribute.description: The URL for sending a payment.

attribute.name: penciler
attribute.description: The individual who draws the primary narrative artwork.

attribute.name: percentile10
attribute.description: The 10th percentile value.

attribute.name: percentile25
attribute.description: The 25th percentile value.

attribute.name: percentile75
attribute.description: The 75th percentile value.

attribute.name: percentile90
attribute.description: The 90th percentile value.

attribute.name: performTime
attribute.description: The length of time it takes to perform instructions or a direction (not including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

attribute.name: performer
attribute.description: A performer at the event—for example, a presenter, musician, musical group or actor.

attribute.name: performerIn
attribute.description: Event that this person is a performer or participant in.

attribute.name: performers
attribute.description: The main performer or performers of the event—for example, a presenter, musician, or actor.

attribute.name: permissionType
attribute.description: The type of permission granted the person, organization, or audience.

attribute.name: permissions
attribute.description: Permission(s) required to run the app (for example, a mobile app may require full internet access or may run only on wifi).

attribute.name: permitAudience
attribute.description: The target audience for this permit.

attribute.name: permittedUsage
attribute.description: Indications regarding the permitted usage of the accommodation.

attribute.name: petsAllowed
attribute.description: Indicates whether pets are allowed to enter the accommodation or lodging business. More detailed information can be put in a text value.

attribute.name: phoneticText
attribute.description: Representation of a text [[textValue]] using the specified [[speechToTextMarkup]]. For example the city name of Houston in IPA: /ˈhjuːstən/.

attribute.name: photo
attribute.description: A photograph of this place.

attribute.name: photos
attribute.description: Photographs of this place.

attribute.name: physicalRequirement
attribute.description: A description of the types of physical activity associated with the job. Defined terms such as those in O*net may be used, but note that there is no way to specify the level of ability as well as its nature when using a defined term.

attribute.name: physiologicalBenefits
attribute.description: Specific physiologic benefits associated to the plan.

attribute.name: pickupLocation
attribute.description: Where a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

attribute.name: pickupTime
attribute.description: When a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

attribute.name: playMode
attribute.description: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player. The game can be marked as multi-player, co-op and single-player at the same time.

attribute.name: playerType
attribute.description: Player type required—for example, Flash or Silverlight.

attribute.name: playersOnline
attribute.description: Number of players on the server.

attribute.name: polygon
attribute.description: A polygon is the area enclosed by a point-to-point path for which the starting and ending points are the same. A polygon is expressed as a series of four or more space delimited points where the first and final points are identical.

attribute.name: populationType
attribute.description: Indicates the populationType common to all members of a [[StatisticalPopulation]] or all cases within the scope of a [[StatisticalVariable]].

attribute.name: position
attribute.description: The position of an item in a series or sequence of items.

attribute.name: positiveNotes
attribute.description:
Provides positive considerations regarding something, for example product highlights or (alongside [[negativeNotes]]) pro/con lists for reviews.
In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described.
The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most positive is at the beginning of the list).

attribute.name: possibleComplication
attribute.description: A possible unexpected and unfavorable evolution of a medical condition. Complications may include worsening of the signs or symptoms of the disease, extension of the condition to other organ systems, etc.

attribute.name: possibleTreatment
attribute.description: A possible treatment to address this condition, sign or symptom.

attribute.name: postOfficeBoxNumber
attribute.description: The post office box number for PO box addresses.

attribute.name: postOp
attribute.description: A description of the postoperative procedures, care, and/or followups for this device.

attribute.name: postalCode
attribute.description: The postal code. For example, 94043.

attribute.name: postalCodeBegin
attribute.description: First postal code in a range (included).

attribute.name: postalCodeEnd
attribute.description: Last postal code in the range (included). Needs to be after [[postalCodeBegin]].

attribute.name: postalCodePrefix
attribute.description: A defined range of postal codes indicated by a common textual prefix. Used for non-numeric systems such as UK.

attribute.name: postalCodeRange
attribute.description: A defined range of postal codes.

attribute.name: potentialAction
attribute.description: Indicates a potential Action, which describes an idealized action in which this thing would play an 'object' role.

attribute.name: potentialUse
attribute.description: Intended use of the BioChemEntity by humans.

attribute.name: practicesAt
attribute.description: A [[MedicalOrganization]] where the [[IndividualPhysician]] practices.

attribute.name: preOp
attribute.description: A description of the workup, testing, and other preparations required before implanting this device.

attribute.name: predecessorOf
attribute.description: A pointer from a previous, often discontinued variant of the product to its newer variant.

attribute.name: pregnancyCategory
attribute.description: Pregnancy category of this drug.

attribute.name: pregnancyWarning
attribute.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use during pregnancy.

attribute.name: prepTime
attribute.description: The length of time it takes to prepare the items to be used in instructions or a direction, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

attribute.name: preparation
attribute.description: Typical preparation that a patient must undergo before having the procedure performed.

attribute.name: prescribingInfo
attribute.description: Link to prescribing information for the drug.

attribute.name: prescriptionStatus
attribute.description: Indicates the status of drug prescription, e.g. local catalogs classifications or whether the drug is available by prescription or over-the-counter, etc.

attribute.name: previousItem
attribute.description: A link to the ListItem that precedes the current one.

attribute.name: previousStartDate
attribute.description: Used in conjunction with eventStatus for rescheduled or cancelled events. This property contains the previously scheduled start date. For rescheduled events, the startDate property should be used for the newly scheduled start date. In the (rare) case of an event that has been postponed and rescheduled multiple times, this field may be repeated.

attribute.name: price
attribute.description:
The offer price of a product, or of a price component when attached to PriceSpecification and its subtypes.

Usage guidelines:

* Use the [[priceCurrency]] property (with standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR") instead of including [ambiguous symbols](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dollar_sign#Currencies_that_use_the_dollar_or_peso_sign) such as '$' in the value.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.
* Note that both [RDFa](http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml-rdfa-primer/#using-the-content-attribute) and Microdata syntax allow the use of a "content=" attribute for publishing simple machine-readable values alongside more human-friendly formatting.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.

attribute.name: priceComponent
attribute.description: This property links to all [[UnitPriceSpecification]] nodes that apply in parallel for the [[CompoundPriceSpecification]] node.

attribute.name: priceComponentType
attribute.description: Identifies a price component (for example, a line item on an invoice), part of the total price for an offer.

attribute.name: priceCurrency
attribute.description: The currency of the price, or a price component when attached to [[PriceSpecification]] and its subtypes.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".
attribute.applies_to: Ticket, TradeAction, DonateAction, Offer, Reservation, PriceSpecification

attribute.name: priceRange
attribute.description: The price range of the business, for example ```$$$```.

attribute.name: priceSpecification
attribute.description: One or more detailed price specifications, indicating the unit price and delivery or payment charges.

attribute.name: priceType
attribute.description: Defines the type of a price specified for an offered product, for example a list price, a (temporary) sale price or a manufacturer suggested retail price. If multiple prices are specified for an offer the [[priceType]] property can be used to identify the type of each such specified price. The value of priceType can be specified as a value from enumeration PriceTypeEnumeration or, a UN/EDIFACT 5387 code, or as a free form text string for price types that are not already predefined in PriceTypeEnumeration.

attribute.name: priceValidUntil
attribute.description: The date after which the price is no longer available.

attribute.name: primaryImageOfPage
attribute.description: Indicates the main image on the page.

attribute.name: primaryPrevention
attribute.description: A preventative therapy used to prevent an initial occurrence of the medical condition, such as vaccination.

attribute.name: printColumn
attribute.description: The number of the column in which the NewsArticle appears in the print edition.

attribute.name: printEdition
attribute.description: The edition of the print product in which the NewsArticle appears.

attribute.name: printPage
attribute.description: If this NewsArticle appears in print, this field indicates the name of the page on which the article is found. Please note that this field is intended for the exact page name (e.g. A5, B18).

attribute.name: printSection
attribute.description: If this NewsArticle appears in print, this field indicates the print section in which the article appeared.

attribute.name: procedure
attribute.description: A description of the procedure involved in setting up, using, and/or installing the device.

attribute.name: procedureType
attribute.description: The type of procedure, for example Surgical, Noninvasive, or Percutaneous.

attribute.name: processingTime
attribute.description: Estimated processing time for the service using this channel.

attribute.name: processorRequirements
attribute.description: Processor architecture required to run the application (e.g. IA64).

attribute.name: producer
attribute.description: The person or organization who produced the work (e.g. music album, movie, TV/radio series etc.).

attribute.name: produces
attribute.description: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.

attribute.name: productGroupID
attribute.description: Indicates a textual identifier for a ProductGroup.

attribute.name: productID
attribute.description: The product identifier, such as ISBN. For example: ``` meta itemprop="productID" content="isbn:123-456-789" ```.

attribute.name: productSupported
attribute.description: The product or service this support contact point is related to (such as product support for a particular product line). This can be a specific product or product line (e.g. "iPhone") or a general category of products or services (e.g. "smartphones").

attribute.name: productionCompany
attribute.description: The production company or studio responsible for the item, e.g. series, video game, episode etc.
attribute.applies_to: MediaObject, RadioSeries, TVSeries, Episode, CreativeWorkSeason, MovieSeries, Movie, VideoGameSeries

attribute.name: productionDate
attribute.description: The date of production of the item, e.g. vehicle.

attribute.name: proficiencyLevel
attribute.description: Proficiency needed for this content; expected values: 'Beginner', 'Expert'.

attribute.name: program
attribute.description: The [MemberProgram](https://schema.org/MemberProgram) associated with a [ProgramMembership](https://schema.org/ProgramMembership).

attribute.name: programMembershipUsed
attribute.description: Any membership in a frequent flyer, hotel loyalty program, etc. being applied to the reservation.

attribute.name: programName
attribute.description: The program providing the membership. It is preferable to use [:program](https://schema.org/program) instead.

attribute.name: programPrerequisites
attribute.description: Prerequisites for enrolling in the program.

attribute.name: programType
attribute.description: The type of educational or occupational program. For example, classroom, internship, alternance, etc.

attribute.name: programmingLanguage
attribute.description: The computer programming language.

attribute.name: programmingModel
attribute.description: Indicates whether API is managed or unmanaged.

attribute.name: pronouns
attribute.description:
A short string listing or describing pronouns for a person. Typically the person concerned is the best authority as pronouns are a critical part of personal identity and expression. Publishers and consumers of this information are reminded to treat this data responsibly, take country-specific laws related to gender expression into account, and be wary of out-of-date data and drawing unwarranted inferences about the person being described.
In English, formulations such as "they/them", "she/her", and "he/him" are commonly used online and can also be used here. We do not intend to enumerate all possible micro-syntaxes in all languages. More structured and well-defined external values for pronouns can be referenced using the [[StructuredValue]] or [[DefinedTerm]] values.

attribute.name: propertyID
attribute.description: A commonly used identifier for the characteristic represented by the property, e.g. a manufacturer or a standard code for a property. propertyID can be (1) a prefixed string, mainly meant to be used with standards for product properties; (2) a site-specific, non-prefixed string (e.g. the primary key of the property or the vendor-specific ID of the property), or (3) a URL indicating the type of the property, either pointing to an external vocabulary, or a Web resource that describes the property (e.g. a glossary entry). Standards bodies should promote a standard prefix for the identifiers of properties from their standards.

attribute.name: proprietaryName
attribute.description: Proprietary name given to the diet plan, typically by its originator or creator.

attribute.name: proteinContent
attribute.description: The number of grams of protein.

attribute.name: provider
attribute.description: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.
attribute.applies_to: Service, CreativeWork, FinancialIncentive, EducationalOccupationalProgram, ParcelDelivery, Invoice, Reservation, Action, Trip

attribute.name: providerMobility
attribute.description: Indicates the mobility of a provided service (e.g. 'static', 'dynamic').

attribute.name: providesBroadcastService
attribute.description: The BroadcastService offered on this channel.

attribute.name: providesService
attribute.description: The service provided by this channel.

attribute.name: publicAccess
attribute.description: A flag to signal that the [[Place]] is open to public visitors. If this property is omitted there is no assumed default boolean value.

attribute.name: publicTransportClosuresInfo
attribute.description: Information about public transport closures.

attribute.name: publication
attribute.description: A publication event associated with the item.

attribute.name: publicationType
attribute.description: The type of the medical article, taken from the US NLM MeSH publication type catalog. See also [MeSH documentation](http://www.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/pubtypes.html).

attribute.name: publishedBy
attribute.description: An agent associated with the publication event.

attribute.name: publishedOn
attribute.description: A broadcast service associated with the publication event.

attribute.name: publisher
attribute.description: The publisher of the article in question.

attribute.name: publisherImprint
attribute.description: The publishing division which published the comic.

attribute.name: publishingPrinciples
attribute.description:
The publishingPrinciples property indicates (typically via [[URL]]) a document describing the editorial principles of an [[Organization]] (or individual, e.g. a [[Person]] writing a blog) that relate to their activities as a publisher, e.g. ethics or diversity policies. When applied to a [[CreativeWork]] (e.g. [[NewsArticle]]) the principles are those of the party primarily responsible for the creation of the [[CreativeWork]].
While such policies are most typically expressed in natural language, sometimes related information (e.g. indicating a [[funder]]) can be expressed using schema.org terminology.

attribute.name: purchaseDate
attribute.description: The date the item, e.g. vehicle, was purchased by the current owner.

attribute.name: purchasePriceLimit
attribute.description: Optional. The maximum price the item can have and still qualify for this offer.

attribute.name: purchaseType
attribute.description: Optional. The type of purchase the consumer must make in order to qualify for this incentive.

attribute.name: qualifications
attribute.description: Specific qualifications required for this role or Occupation.

attribute.name: qualifiedExpense
attribute.description: Optional. The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

attribute.name: quarantineGuidelines
attribute.description: Guidelines about quarantine rules, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

attribute.name: query
attribute.description: A sub property of instrument. The query used on this action.

attribute.name: quest
attribute.description: The task that a player-controlled character, or group of characters may complete in order to gain a reward.

attribute.name: question
attribute.description: A sub property of object. A question.

attribute.name: rangeIncludes
attribute.description: Relates a property to a class that constitutes (one of) the expected type(s) for values of the property.

attribute.name: ratingCount
attribute.description: The count of total number of ratings.

attribute.name: ratingExplanation
attribute.description: A short explanation (e.g. one to two sentences) providing background context and other information that led to the conclusion expressed in the rating. This is particularly applicable to ratings associated with "fact check" markup using [[ClaimReview]].

attribute.name: ratingValue
attribute.description:
The rating for the content.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

attribute.name: readBy
attribute.description: A person who reads (performs) the audiobook.

attribute.name: readonlyValue
attribute.description: Whether or not a property is mutable. Default is false. Specifying this for a property that also has a value makes it act similar to a "hidden" input in an HTML form.

attribute.name: realEstateAgent
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The real estate agent involved in the action.

attribute.name: recipe
attribute.description: A sub property of instrument. The recipe/instructions used to perform the action.

attribute.name: recipeCategory
attribute.description: The category of the recipe—for example, appetizer, entree, etc.

attribute.name: recipeCuisine
attribute.description: The cuisine of the recipe (for example, French or Ethiopian).

attribute.name: recipeIngredient
attribute.description: An ingredient or ordered list of ingredients and potentially quantities used in the recipe, e.g. 1 cup of sugar, flour or garlic. The ingredients can be represented as free text or more structured values.

attribute.name: recipeInstructions
attribute.description: A step in making the recipe, in the form of a single item (document, video, etc.) or an ordered list with HowToStep and/or HowToSection items.

attribute.name: recipeYield
attribute.description: The quantity produced by the recipe (for example, number of people served, number of servings, etc).

attribute.name: recipient
attribute.description: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the receiving end of the action.
attribute.applies_to: AuthorizeAction, Message, SendAction, ReturnAction, TipAction, CommunicateAction, GiveAction, DonateAction, PayAction

attribute.name: recognizedBy
attribute.description: An organization that acknowledges the validity, value or utility of a credential. Note: recognition may include a process of quality assurance or accreditation.

attribute.name: recognizingAuthority
attribute.description: If applicable, the organization that officially recognizes this entity as part of its endorsed system of medicine.

attribute.name: recommendationStrength
attribute.description: Strength of the guideline's recommendation (e.g. 'class I').

attribute.name: recommendedIntake
attribute.description: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

attribute.name: recordLabel
attribute.description: The label that issued the release.

attribute.name: recordedAs
attribute.description: An audio recording of the work.

attribute.name: recordedAt
attribute.description: The Event where the CreativeWork was recorded. The CreativeWork may capture all or part of the event.

attribute.name: recordedIn
attribute.description: The CreativeWork that captured all or part of this Event.

attribute.name: recordingOf
attribute.description: The composition this track is a recording of.

attribute.name: recourseLoan
attribute.description: The only way you get the money back in the event of default is the security. Recourse is where you still have the opportunity to go back to the borrower for the rest of the money.

attribute.name: referee
attribute.description: An official who watches a game or match closely to enforce the rules and arbitrate on matters arising from the play such as referees, umpires or judges. The name of the effective function can vary according to the sport.

attribute.name: referenceQuantity
attribute.description: The reference quantity for which a certain price applies, e.g. 1 EUR per 4 kWh of electricity. This property is a replacement for unitOfMeasurement for the advanced cases where the price does not relate to a standard unit.

attribute.name: referencesOrder
attribute.description: The Order(s) related to this Invoice. One or more Orders may be combined into a single Invoice.

attribute.name: refundType
attribute.description: A refund type, from an enumerated list.

attribute.name: regionDrained
attribute.description: The anatomical or organ system drained by this vessel; generally refers to a specific part of an organ.

attribute.name: regionsAllowed
attribute.description: The regions where the media is allowed. If not specified, then it's assumed to be allowed everywhere. Specify the countries in [ISO 3166 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166).

attribute.name: relatedAnatomy
attribute.description: Anatomical systems or structures that relate to the superficial anatomy.

attribute.name: relatedCondition
attribute.description: A medical condition associated with this anatomy.

attribute.name: relatedDrug
attribute.description: Any other drug related to this one, for example commonly-prescribed alternatives.

attribute.name: relatedLink
attribute.description: A link related to this web page, for example to other related web pages.

attribute.name: relatedStructure
attribute.description: Related anatomical structure(s) that are not part of the system but relate or connect to it, such as vascular bundles associated with an organ system.

attribute.name: relatedTherapy
attribute.description: A medical therapy related to this anatomy.

attribute.name: relatedTo
attribute.description: The most generic familial relation.

attribute.name: releaseDate
attribute.description: The release date of a product or product model. This can be used to distinguish the exact variant of a product.

attribute.name: releaseNotes
attribute.description: Description of what changed in this version.

attribute.name: releaseOf
attribute.description: The album this is a release of.

attribute.name: releasedEvent
attribute.description: The place and time the release was issued, expressed as a PublicationEvent.

attribute.name: relevantOccupation
attribute.description: The Occupation for the JobPosting.

attribute.name: relevantSpecialty
attribute.description: If applicable, a medical specialty in which this entity is relevant.

attribute.name: remainingAttendeeCapacity
attribute.description: The number of attendee places for an event that remain unallocated.

attribute.name: renegotiableLoan
attribute.description: Whether the terms for payment of interest can be renegotiated during the life of the loan.

attribute.name: repeatCount
attribute.description: Defines the number of times a recurring [[Event]] will take place.

attribute.name: repeatFrequency
attribute.description: Defines the frequency at which [[Event]]s will occur according to a schedule [[Schedule]]. The intervals between events should be defined as a [[Duration]] of time.

attribute.name: repetitions
attribute.description: Number of times one should repeat the activity.

attribute.name: replacee
attribute.description: A sub property of object. The object that is being replaced.

attribute.name: replacer
attribute.description: A sub property of object. The object that replaces.

attribute.name: replyToUrl
attribute.description: The URL at which a reply may be posted to the specified UserComment.

attribute.name: reportNumber
attribute.description: The number or other unique designator assigned to a Report by the publishing organization.

attribute.name: representativeOfPage
attribute.description: Indicates whether this image is representative of the content of the page.

attribute.name: requiredCollateral
attribute.description: Assets required to secure loan or credit repayments. It may take form of third party pledge, goods, financial instruments (cash, securities, etc.)

attribute.name: requiredGender
attribute.description: Audiences defined by a person's gender.

attribute.name: requiredMaxAge
attribute.description: Audiences defined by a person's maximum age.

attribute.name: requiredMinAge
attribute.description: Audiences defined by a person's minimum age.

attribute.name: requiredQuantity
attribute.description: The required quantity of the item(s).

attribute.name: requirements
attribute.description: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).

attribute.name: requiresSubscription
attribute.description: Indicates if use of the media require a subscription (either paid or free). Allowed values are ```true``` or ```false``` (note that an earlier version had 'yes', 'no').

attribute.name: reservationFor
attribute.description: The thing -- flight, event, restaurant, etc. being reserved.

attribute.name: reservationId
attribute.description: A unique identifier for the reservation.

attribute.name: reservationStatus
attribute.description: The current status of the reservation.

attribute.name: reservedTicket
attribute.description: A ticket associated with the reservation.

attribute.name: responsibilities
attribute.description: Responsibilities associated with this role or Occupation.

attribute.name: restPeriods
attribute.description: How often one should break from the activity.

attribute.name: restockingFee
attribute.description: Use [[MonetaryAmount]] to specify a fixed restocking fee for product returns, or use [[Number]] to specify a percentage of the product price paid by the customer.

attribute.name: result
attribute.description: The result produced in the action. E.g. John wrote *a book*.

attribute.name: resultComment
attribute.description: A sub property of result. The Comment created or sent as a result of this action.

attribute.name: resultReview
attribute.description: A sub property of result. The review that resulted in the performing of the action.

attribute.name: returnFees
attribute.description: The type of return fees for purchased products (for any return reason).

attribute.name: returnLabelSource
attribute.description: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned for any reason.

attribute.name: returnMethod
attribute.description: The type of return method offered, specified from an enumeration.

attribute.name: returnPolicyCategory
attribute.description: Specifies an applicable return policy (from an enumeration).

attribute.name: returnPolicyCountry
attribute.description: The country where the product has to be sent to for returns, for example "Ireland" using the [[name]] property of [[Country]]. You can also provide the two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1). Note that this can be different from the country where the product was originally shipped from or sent to.

attribute.name: returnPolicySeasonalOverride
attribute.description: Seasonal override of a return policy.

attribute.name: returnShippingFeesAmount
attribute.description: Amount of shipping costs for product returns (for any reason). Applicable when property [[returnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

attribute.name: review
attribute.description: A review of the item.
attribute.applies_to: Brand, Offer, Place, Organization, Event, Service, CreativeWork, Product

attribute.name: reviewAspect
attribute.description: This Review or Rating is relevant to this part or facet of the itemReviewed.

attribute.name: reviewBody
attribute.description: The actual body of the review.

attribute.name: reviewCount
attribute.description: The count of total number of reviews.

attribute.name: reviewRating
attribute.description: The rating given in this review. Note that reviews can themselves be rated. The ```reviewRating``` applies to rating given by the review. The [[aggregateRating]] property applies to the review itself, as a creative work.

attribute.name: reviewedBy
attribute.description: People or organizations that have reviewed the content on this web page for accuracy and/or completeness.

attribute.name: reviews
attribute.description: Review of the item.

attribute.name: riskFactor
attribute.description: A modifiable or non-modifiable factor that increases the risk of a patient contracting this condition, e.g. age, coexisting condition.

attribute.name: risks
attribute.description: Specific physiologic risks associated to the diet plan.

attribute.name: roleName
attribute.description: A role played, performed or filled by a person or organization. For example, the team of creators for a comic book might fill the roles named 'inker', 'penciller', and 'letterer'; or an athlete in a SportsTeam might play in the position named 'Quarterback'.

attribute.name: roofLoad
attribute.description:
The permitted total weight of cargo and installations (e.g. a roof rack) on top of the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]]
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

attribute.name: rsvpResponse
attribute.description: The response (yes, no, maybe) to the RSVP.

attribute.name: runsTo
attribute.description: The vasculature the lymphatic structure runs, or efferents, to.

attribute.name: runtime
attribute.description: Runtime platform or script interpreter dependencies (example: Java v1, Python 2.3, .NET Framework 3.0).

attribute.name: runtimePlatform
attribute.description: Runtime platform or script interpreter dependencies (example: Java v1, Python 2.3, .NET Framework 3.0).

attribute.name: rxcui
attribute.description: The RxCUI drug identifier from RXNORM.

attribute.name: safetyConsideration
attribute.description: Any potential safety concern associated with the supplement. May include interactions with other drugs and foods, pregnancy, breastfeeding, known adverse reactions, and documented efficacy of the supplement.

attribute.name: salaryCurrency
attribute.description: The currency (coded using [ISO 4217](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217)) used for the main salary information in this job posting or for this employee.

attribute.name: salaryUponCompletion
attribute.description: The expected salary upon completing the training.

attribute.name: sameAs
attribute.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

attribute.name: sampleType
attribute.description: What type of code sample: full (compile ready) solution, code snippet, inline code, scripts, template.

attribute.name: saturatedFatContent
attribute.description: The number of grams of saturated fat.

attribute.name: scheduleTimezone
attribute.description: Indicates the timezone for which the time(s) indicated in the [[Schedule]] are given. The value provided should be among those listed in the IANA Time Zone Database.

attribute.name: scheduledPaymentDate
attribute.description: The date the invoice is scheduled to be paid.

attribute.name: scheduledTime
attribute.description: The time the object is scheduled to.

attribute.name: schemaVersion
attribute.description: Indicates (by URL or string) a particular version of a schema used in some CreativeWork. This property was created primarily to indicate the use of a specific schema.org release, e.g. ```10.0``` as a simple string, or more explicitly via URL, ```https://schema.org/docs/releases.html#v10.0```. There may be situations in which other schemas might usefully be referenced this way, e.g. ```http://dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dces/1999-07-02/``` but this has not been carefully explored in the community.

attribute.name: schoolClosuresInfo
attribute.description: Information about school closures.

attribute.name: screenCount
attribute.description: The number of screens in the movie theater.

attribute.name: screenshot
attribute.description: A link to a screenshot image of the app.

attribute.name: sdDatePublished
attribute.description: Indicates the date on which the current structured data was generated / published. Typically used alongside [[sdPublisher]].

attribute.name: sdLicense
attribute.description: A license document that applies to this structured data, typically indicated by URL.

attribute.name: sdPublisher
attribute.description: Indicates the party responsible for generating and publishing the current structured data markup, typically in cases where the structured data is derived automatically from existing published content but published on a different site. For example, student projects and open data initiatives often re-publish existing content with more explicitly structured metadata. The [[sdPublisher]] property helps make such practices more explicit.

attribute.name: season
attribute.description: A season in a media series.

attribute.name: seasonNumber
attribute.description: Position of the season within an ordered group of seasons.

attribute.name: seasonalOverride
attribute.description: Limited period during which these shipping conditions apply.

attribute.name: seasons
attribute.description: A season in a media series.

attribute.name: seatNumber
attribute.description: The location of the reserved seat (e.g., 27).

attribute.name: seatRow
attribute.description: The row location of the reserved seat (e.g., B).

attribute.name: seatSection
attribute.description: The section location of the reserved seat (e.g. Orchestra).

attribute.name: seatingCapacity
attribute.description: The number of persons that can be seated (e.g. in a vehicle), both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

attribute.name: seatingType
attribute.description: The type/class of the seat.

attribute.name: secondaryPrevention
attribute.description: A preventative therapy used to prevent reoccurrence of the medical condition after an initial episode of the condition.

attribute.name: securityClearanceRequirement

attribute.name: securityScreening

attribute.name: seeks
